options.C: Request strongly consistent reads for the table.
options.D: Request eventually consistent reads for the table.

radar.signal: Lectures qui ne renvoient pas la derniere ecriture -> demander des strongly consistent reads

pieges.A: DynamoDB n'a pas de 'read replicas' a ajouter comme une base relationnelle
pieges.B: Un GSI sert des acces par autre cle, il ne corrige pas la fraicheur des donnees
pieges.D: Les lectures eventually consistent sont justement la cause du probleme

explication: Par defaut, DynamoDB fait des lectures eventually consistent qui peuvent renvoyer une valeur legerement anterieure. Demander des strongly consistent reads garantit d'obtenir la derniere ecriture validee, ce qui resout exactement le symptome decrit.

question: A company wants to enhance its ecommerce order-processing application that is deployed on AWS. The application must process each order exactly once without affecting the customer experience during unpredictable traffic surges. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Put all the orders in the SQS queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic. Publish all the orders to the SNS standard topic. Configure the application as a notification target.
options.C: Create a flow by using Amazon AppFlow. Send the orders to the flow. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders.
options.D: Configure AWS X-Ray in the application to track the order requests. Configure the application to process the orders by pulling the orders from Amazon CloudWatch.

radar.signal: Traitement exactly-once et absorption des pics -> file SQS FIFO + Lambda comme cible

pieges.B: Un topic SNS standard peut delivrer des doublons et n'ordonne pas
pieges.C: AppFlow orchestre des transferts SaaS, pas un traitement de commandes exactly-once
pieges.D: X-Ray/CloudWatch servent au traçage/monitoring, pas au traitement des commandes

explication: Une file SQS FIFO garantit un traitement exactly-once (deduplication) et decouple la reception du traitement, absorbant les pics de trafic. Une Lambda consomme la file pour traiter chaque commande une seule fois. SNS standard risquerait des doublons.

question: A company has two AWS accounts: Production and Development. The company needs to push code changes in the Development account to the Production account. In the alpha phase, only two senior developers on the development team need access to the Production account. In the beta phase, more developers will need access to perform testing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create two policy documents by using the AWS Management Console in each account. Assign the policy to developers who need access.
options.B: Create an IAM role in the Development account. Grant the IAM role access to the Production account. Allow developers to assume the role.
options.C: Create an IAM role in the Production account. Define a trust policy that specifies the Development account. Allow developers to assume the role.
options.D: Create an IAM group in the Production account. Add the group as a principal in a trust policy that specifies the Production account. Add developers to the group.

declencheurs: push code from Development to Production
radar.signal: Acces cross-account evolutif -> role IAM dans le compte Production avec trust policy autorisant le compte Development ; les developpeurs assument le role

pieges.A: Des policies dupliquees par utilisateur ne passent pas a l'echelle
pieges.B: Le role doit exister dans le compte cible (Production), pas dans Development
pieges.D: Un IAM group ne se met pas en principal d'une trust policy, et la formulation est incoherente

explication: Le modele cross-account standard : creer un role IAM dans le compte Production dont la trust policy autorise le compte Development. Les developpeurs habilites assument ce role pour agir en Production. Pour passer de 2 developpeurs a davantage, il suffit d'accorder l'assume-role, ce qui est parfaitement evolutif.

question: A company application is having performance issues. The application is stateful and needs to complete in-memory tasks on Amazon EC2 instances. The company used AWS CloudFormation to deploy infrastructure and used the M5 EC2 instance family. As traffic increased, the application performance degraded. Users are reporting delays when the users attempt to access the application. Which solution will resolve these issues in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Replace the EC2 instances with T3 EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. Make the changes by using the AWS Management Console.
options.B: Modify the CloudFormation templates to run the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. Increase the desired capacity and the maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group manually when an increase is necessary.
options.C: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch built-in EC2 memory metrics to track the application performance for future capacity planning.
options.D: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to generate custom application latency metrics for future capacity planning.

radar.signal: Charge in-memory -> instances optimisees memoire R5 (via CloudFormation) + agent CloudWatch pour des metriques de latence custom

pieges.A: T3 (burstable) est moins adapte qu'une famille memoire, et modifier hors CloudFormation cree du drift
pieges.B: Auto Scaling manuel ne cible pas la cause (memoire) pour une app stateful in-memory
pieges.C: Il n'existe pas de metrique memoire 'built-in' EC2 dans CloudWatch : il faut l'agent

explication: Des taches in-memory sont limitees par la RAM : passer a la famille R5 (optimisee memoire) via les templates CloudFormation (pour eviter le drift) resout la degradation. Comme CloudWatch ne fournit pas nativement de metrique memoire, on deploie l'agent CloudWatch pour collecter des metriques de latence/memoire custom en vue du capacity planning.

question: A solutions architect is designing a new API using Amazon API Gateway that will receive requests from users. The volume of requests is highly variable; several hours can pass without receiving a single request. The data processing will take place asynchronously, but should be completed within a few seconds after a request is made. Which compute service should the solutions architect have the API invoke to deliver the requirements at the lowest cost?

options.A: An AWS Glue job
options.B: An AWS Lambda function
options.C: A containerized service hosted in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.D: A containerized service hosted in Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2

radar.signal: Compute evenementiel a trafic tres irregulier et bref -> AWS Lambda (ne facture qu'a l'usage)

pieges.A: Un job Glue est fait pour l'ETL par lots, pas des reponses en quelques secondes
pieges.C: EKS = cluster toujours actif a payer meme sans trafic
pieges.D: ECS sur EC2 = instances facturees en continu

explication: AWS Lambda ne coute rien lorsqu'il n'y a pas de requetes et demarre a la demande pour traiter en quelques secondes, ce qui correspond exactement a un trafic tres variable avec de longues periodes d'inactivite. Les options conteneurs (EKS/ECS-EC2) facturent des ressources en permanence.

question: A company uses high block storage capacity to run its workloads on premises. The company's daily peak input and output transactions per second are not more than 15,000 IOPS. The company wants to migrate the workloads to Amazon EC2 and to provision disk performance independent of storage capacity. Which Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume type will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: GP2 volume type
options.B: io2 volume type
options.C: GP3 volume type
options.D: io1 volume type

radar.signal: IOPS decouplees de la capacite, a moindre cout, jusqu'a 16000 IOPS -> volume EBS gp3

pieges.A: gp2 lie les IOPS a la taille du volume (non decouple)
pieges.B: io2 est plus cher, justifie surtout au-dela de gp3 ou pour la durabilite
pieges.D: io1 est plus cher que gp3 pour ce niveau d'IOPS

explication: gp3 permet de provisionner les IOPS (jusqu'a 16000) et le debit independamment de la capacite de stockage, ce qui couvre les 15000 IOPS demandees a un cout inferieur aux volumes io1/io2. gp2, lui, fait dependre les IOPS de la taille du volume.

question: A company needs to store data from its healthcare application. The application's data frequently changes. A new regulation requires audit access at all levels of the stored data. The company hosts the application on an on-premises infrastructure that is running out of storage capacity. A solutions architect must securely migrate the existing data to AWS while satisfying the new regulation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events.
options.B: Use AWS Snowcone to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.

declencheurs: audit access at ALL levels of stored data
radar.signal: Migrer vers S3 + auditer les acces aux DONNEES -> AWS DataSync + CloudTrail data events

pieges.B: Snowcone = petit appareil hors ligne ; CloudTrail management events ne trace pas l'acces aux objets
pieges.C: Transfer Acceleration accelere l'upload mais data events seulement complet ici via CloudTrail (option correcte mais le transfert n'est pas le plus adapte a un gros volume regulier)
pieges.D: Storage Gateway + management events ne journalise pas l'acces au niveau des objets

explication: AWS DataSync migre les donnees vers S3 de facon securisee et validee. Pour auditer l'acces a tous les niveaux des donnees, il faut activer les CloudTrail data events (qui journalisent les operations au niveau des objets S3), et non les management events qui ne couvrent que les actions de gestion.

question: A solutions architect must create a disaster recovery (DR) plan for a high-volume software as a service (SaaS) platform. All data for the platform is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The DR plan must replicate data to a secondary AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use MySQL binary log replication to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Provision one DB instance for the Aurora cluster in the secondary Region.
options.B: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. When setup is complete, remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to continuously replicate data to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.D: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. Specify a minimum of one DB instance in the secondary Region.

radar.signal: Replication cross-Region managee d'Aurora pour du DR -> Aurora global database avec au moins une instance en Region secondaire

pieges.A: La replication binlog MySQL maison = a operer soi-meme, moins fiable/managee
pieges.C: DMS en continu = overhead de replication et de gestion superflu ici
pieges.B: Retirer toute instance (secondaire headless) reduit le cout mais rallonge le RTO

explication: Aurora global database replique nativement au niveau du stockage vers la Region secondaire avec une faible latence, ce qui est la solution manageee pour du DR. La cle retient une instance minimale en secondaire (D). Nuance : un secondaire 'headless' (option B, sans instance) coute encore moins cher car la replication est au niveau du stockage, au prix d'un RTO plus long (il faut ajouter une instance avant bascule).

question: A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. Management says the application must be made more secure with the least amount of programming effort. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create keys. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation.
options.B: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function that rotates the credentials in Secrets Manager.
options.C: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager.
options.D: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Parameter Store.

radar.signal: Securiser des identifiants de base avec le moins de code -> AWS Secrets Manager + rotation planifiee native (integree a RDS)

pieges.A: KMS chiffre des cles, il ne stocke/rote pas des identifiants de base
pieges.B: Ecrire une Lambda de rotation = du code a developper (evitable)
pieges.D: Parameter Store n'offre pas la rotation automatique native des identifiants

explication: Secrets Manager stocke les identifiants et gere une rotation planifiee native pour RDS (rotation Lambda geree par le service), sans code custom a ecrire. L'application charge le secret au lieu d'avoir des identifiants embarques. L'option B imposerait de coder soi-meme la rotation.

question: A marketing company receives a large amount of new clickstream data in Amazon S3 from a marketing campaign. The company needs to analyze the clickstream data in Amazon S3 quickly. Then the company needs to determine whether to process the data further in the data pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create external tables in a Spark catalog. Configure jobs in AWS Glue to query the data.
options.B: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.C: Create external tables in a Hive metastore. Configure Spark jobs in Amazon EMR to query the data.
options.D: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to use SQL to query the data.

radar.signal: Analyser rapidement des donnees S3 sans infra -> Glue crawler (schema) + Amazon Athena (SQL serverless)

pieges.A: Tables externes dans un catalog Spark + jobs Glue = plus de mise en place
pieges.C: Hive metastore + Spark sur EMR = cluster a gerer
pieges.D: Kinesis Data Analytics est fait pour du flux temps reel, pas des donnees deja dans S3

explication: Un crawler AWS Glue deduit le schema des donnees S3, puis Amazon Athena les interroge en SQL sans serveur. C'est le moyen le plus rapide et le moins operationnel d'explorer les donnees avant de decider d'un traitement plus pousse. EMR imposerait un cluster.

question: A company runs an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that the company frequently accesses for up to 7 days after the file creation date. After 7 days, the company needs to be able to access the files with a maximum retrieval time of 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data after 7 days.
options.D: Configure access to Amazon S3 for each user. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days.

radar.signal: Etendre le stockage SMB/S3 + archiver apres 7 jours avec recuperation <= 24h -> S3 File Gateway + Lifecycle vers S3 Glacier Deep Archive apres 7 jours

pieges.A: DataSync copie mais ne fournit pas l'acces SMB local ni le cache
pieges.C: FSx File Gateway ne se combine pas ainsi avec une lifecycle S3
pieges.D: Changer l'acces par utilisateur modifie l'usage SMB actuel

explication: Le S3 File Gateway etend le stockage en preservant l'acces SMB avec cache local pour les fichiers recents (7 jours). Une Lifecycle policy bascule ensuite les fichiers vers S3 Glacier Deep Archive : sa recuperation standard (~12 h) respecte le maximum de 24 h, pour un cout d'archivage minimal.

question: A company is hosting a high-traffic static website on Amazon S3 with an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has a default TTL of 0 seconds. The company wants to implement caching to improve performance for the website. However, the company also wants to ensure that stale content is not served for more than a few minutes after a deployment. Which combination of caching methods should a solutions architect implement to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Set the CloudFront default TTL to 2 minutes.
options.B: Set a default TTL of 2 minutes on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Add a Cache-Control private directive to the objects in Amazon S3.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to add an Expires header to HTTP responses. Configure the function to run on viewer response.
options.E: Add a Cache-Control max-age directive of 24 hours to the objects in Amazon S3. On deployment, create a CloudFront invalidation to clear any changed files from edge caches.

declencheurs: stale content no more than a few minutes after deployment
radar.signal: Cacher tout en limitant le contenu perime -> TTL par defaut CloudFront a 2 min (A) + Cache-Control max-age 24h sur les objets + invalidation CloudFront au deploiement (E)

pieges.B: Il n'existe pas de 'TTL par defaut' a definir sur un bucket S3
pieges.C: Cache-Control private empeche la mise en cache par le CDN (contraire au but)
pieges.D: Un en-tete Expires via Lambda@Edge est plus complexe et ne borne pas la fraicheur au deploiement

explication: Regler le TTL par defaut de CloudFront a 2 minutes (A) garantit qu'un contenu perime n'est servi que quelques minutes au maximum. En parallele, un max-age long (24 h) sur les objets ameliore le cache, et une invalidation CloudFront au moment du deploiement (E) purge immediatement les fichiers modifies. Cache-Control private (C) desactiverait le cache.

question: A company runs its application by using Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Lambda functions. The EC2 instances run in private subnets of a VPC. The Lambda functions need direct network access to the EC2 instances for the application to work. The application will run for 1 year. The number of Lambda functions that the application uses will increase during the 1-year period. The company must minimize costs on all application resources. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances.
options.B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to new public subnets in the same VPC where the EC2 instances run.
options.C: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances.
options.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Keep the Lambda functions in the Lambda service VPC.

declencheurs: Lambda need direct network access to EC2
radar.signal: Reduire le cout d'EC2 + Lambda croissants + acces reseau direct -> Compute Savings Plan (couvre EC2 ET Lambda) + Lambda rattachees aux subnets prives des EC2

pieges.A: Un EC2 Instance Savings Plan ne couvre pas Lambda (dont le nombre augmente)
pieges.B: Mettre les Lambda dans des subnets publics ne donne pas l'acces reseau prive aux EC2
pieges.D: Laisser les Lambda hors du VPC empeche l'acces reseau direct aux EC2 prives

explication: Comme le nombre de Lambda augmente, un Compute Savings Plan est preferable a un EC2 Instance Savings Plan car il couvre a la fois EC2, Lambda et Fargate. Pour l'acces reseau direct, on attache les Lambda aux subnets prives qui hebergent les EC2. C'est la combinaison la plus economique et fonctionnelle.

question: A company has primary and secondary data centers that are 500 miles (804.7 km) apart and interconnected with high-speed fiber-optic cable. The company needs a highly available and secure network connection between its data centers and a VPC on AWS for a mission-critical workload. A solutions architect must choose a connection solution that provides maximum resiliency. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Two AWS Direct Connect connections from the primary data center terminating at two Direct Connect locations on two separate devices.
options.B: A single AWS Direct Connect connection from each of the primary and secondary data centers terminating at one Direct Connect location on the same device.
options.C: Two AWS Direct Connect connections from each of the primary and secondary data centers terminating at two Direct Connect locations on two separate devices.
options.D: A single AWS Direct Connect connection from each of the primary and secondary data centers terminating at one Direct Connect location on two separate devices.

declencheurs: highly available and secure to VPC
radar.signal: Resilience maximale -> deux Direct Connect depuis CHAQUE data center, aboutissant a deux locations DX sur deux appareils distincts

pieges.A: Deux DX depuis le seul data center primaire laisse le site secondaire sans lien
pieges.B: Une seule DX par site, meme location, meme appareil = points de defaillance multiples
pieges.D: Une seule DX par site reste moins resilient que deux DX par site

explication: La resilience maximale s'obtient en redondant a tous les niveaux : deux connexions Direct Connect depuis chacun des deux data centers, terminees a deux locations Direct Connect distinctes et sur des equipements separes. Ainsi, aucune panne d'un site, d'une location ou d'un appareil ne coupe la connectivite.

question: A company runs several Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances that have high utilization. The accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The RDS DB instances run in member accounts. The company's finance team has access to the organization's management account and member accounts. The finance team wants to find ways to optimize costs by using AWS Trusted Advisor. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations in the management account.
options.B: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations in the member accounts where the RDS DB instances are running.
options.C: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization.
options.D: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances.
options.E: Review the Trusted Advisor checks for compute optimization. Crosscheck the results by using AWS Compute Optimizer.

radar.signal: Optimiser des RDS a forte utilisation -> Trusted Advisor dans les comptes membres qui hebergent les RDS (B) + check RDS Reserved Instance Optimization (C)

pieges.A: Le compte de gestion n'est pas la ou s'evaluent ces checks au niveau des instances
pieges.D: Le check 'Idle DB Instances' vise les bases inactives, or elles sont a forte utilisation
pieges.E: Compute Optimizer ne couvre pas l'optimisation des RI RDS

explication: Des instances RDS a forte utilisation qui tournent en continu s'optimisent via des Reserved Instances : on consulte le check Trusted Advisor 'RDS Reserved Instance Optimization' (C) depuis les comptes membres ou tournent les instances (B). Le check 'Idle DB Instances' (D) ne s'applique pas a des bases fortement utilisees.

question: A company wants to give a customer the ability to use on-premises Microsoft Active Directory to download files that are stored in Amazon S3. The customer's application uses an SFTP client to download the files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead and no changes to the customer's application?

options.A: Set up AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.B: Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to synchronize the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.C: Set up AWS DataSync to synchronize between the on-premises location and the S3 location by using AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).
options.D: Set up a Windows Amazon EC2 instance with SFTP to connect the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Integrate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).

radar.signal: Acces SFTP a S3 avec authentification AD, sans changer l'app -> AWS Transfer Family (SFTP) pour S3 + authentification Active Directory integree

pieges.B: DMS migre des bases, il ne fournit pas un endpoint SFTP
pieges.C: DataSync transfere des donnees, ce n'est pas un serveur SFTP pour le client
pieges.D: Un EC2 Windows + SFTP = serveur a gerer soi-meme (plus d'overhead)

explication: AWS Transfer Family expose un endpoint SFTP manage devant S3 et s'integre a Active Directory pour l'authentification. Le client SFTP existant fonctionne sans modification, et il n'y a aucun serveur a exploiter, d'ou le plus faible overhead.

question: A company is experiencing sudden increases in demand. The company needs to provision large Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). The instances will run in an Auto Scaling group. The company needs a solution that provides minimum provisioning latency to meet the demand. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use the aws ec2 register-image command to create an AMI from a snapshot. Use AWS Step Functions to replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Enable Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) fast snapshot restore on a snapshot. Provision an AMI by using the snapshot. Replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group with the new AMI.
options.C: Enable AMI creation and define lifecycle rules in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM). Create an AWS Lambda function that modifies the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Backup lifecycle policies that provision AMIs. Configure Auto Scaling group capacity limits as an event source in EventBridge.

radar.signal: Reduire la latence de provisionnement d'instances depuis un AMI -> EBS Fast Snapshot Restore sur le snapshot, puis AMI base sur ce snapshot

pieges.A: register-image + Step Functions ne supprime pas la latence d'initialisation du volume
pieges.C: DLM gere le cycle de vie des AMI, pas la latence de demarrage
pieges.D: AWS Backup + EventBridge ne cible pas la latence de provisionnement

explication: Sans Fast Snapshot Restore, une nouvelle instance subit l'initialisation lente du volume EBS (blocs charges a la demande depuis S3). En activant FSR sur le snapshot servant a l'AMI, les instances demarrent avec des performances pleines immediatement, minimisant la latence de provisionnement lors des pics.

question: A company wants to build a scalable key management infrastructure to support developers who need to encrypt data in their applications. What should a solutions architect do to reduce the operational burden?

options.A: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to protect the encryption keys.
options.B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create, store, and assign the encryption keys.
options.D: Use an IAM policy to limit the scope of users who have access permissions to protect the encryption keys.

radar.signal: Gestion de cles scalable et manageee -> AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)

pieges.A: La MFA protege des acces, ce n'est pas une infrastructure de gestion de cles
pieges.C: ACM gere des certificats TLS, pas des cles d'application generiques
pieges.D: Une IAM policy limite l'acces mais ne fournit pas la gestion de cles

explication: AWS KMS est le service manage de creation, stockage et controle des cles de chiffrement, scalable et integre aux SDK/services AWS. Il decharge les developpeurs de la gestion des cles. ACM ne gere que des certificats, et MFA/IAM ne sont que des controles d'acces.

question: A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certificate, which is on each instance to perform SSL termination. There has been an increase in traffic recently, and the operations team determined that SSL encryption and decryption is causing the compute capacity of the web servers to reach their maximum limit. What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?

options.A: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination.
options.C: Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances.
options.D: Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM.

radar.signal: Decharger le SSL des serveurs -> importer le certificat dans ACM + Application Load Balancer avec listener HTTPS (terminaison SSL sur l'ALB)

pieges.A: Un certificat ACM sur chaque instance ne decharge pas le CPU (le SSL reste sur l'EC2)
pieges.B: S3 ne fait pas de terminaison SSL
pieges.C: Un EC2 proxy deplace la charge SSL sur un serveur a gerer

explication: En important le certificat dans ACM et en placant un Application Load Balancer avec listener HTTPS, la terminaison SSL est realisee par l'ALB (service manage). Les EC2 sont dechargees du chiffrement/dechiffrement et retrouvent de la capacite. Garder le SSL sur les instances (A) ne resout rien.

question: A company uses a popular content management system (CMS) for its corporate website. However, the required patching and maintenance are burdensome. The company is redesigning its website and wants a new solution. The website will be updated four times a year and does not need to have any dynamic content available. The solution must provide high scalability and enhanced security. Which combination of changes will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront in front of the website to use HTTPS functionality.
options.B: Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL in front of the website to provide HTTPS functionality.
options.C: Create and deploy an AWS Lambda function to manage and serve the website content.
options.D: Create the new website and an Amazon S3 bucket. Deploy the website on the S3 bucket with static website hosting enabled.
options.E: Create the new website. Deploy the website by using an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer.

radar.signal: Site purement statique + securite/scalabilite sans serveurs -> S3 static website hosting (D) + CloudFront devant pour le HTTPS (A)

pieges.B: AWS WAF ne fournit pas le HTTPS ; il filtre les attaques
pieges.C: Une Lambda pour servir le contenu = plus complexe qu'un hebergement statique S3
pieges.E: Un Auto Scaling group d'EC2 derriere un ALB = serveurs a patcher/gerer

explication: Le site n'ayant pas de contenu dynamique, l'heberger en statique sur S3 (D) supprime tout patching de serveur, avec une forte scalabilite. CloudFront place devant (A) apporte le HTTPS, la diffusion mondiale et une securite renforcee. WAF (B) ne fournit pas le HTTPS, et une flotte EC2 (E) reintroduirait la maintenance a eviter.

question: A company stores its application logs in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. A new policy requires the company to store all application logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) in near-real time. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription to stream the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Use the log group to invoke the function to write the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the log group as the delivery stream's source. Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) as the delivery stream's destination.
options.D: Install and configure Amazon Kinesis Agent on each application server to deliver the logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Configure Kinesis Data Streams to deliver the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).

declencheurs: store in OpenSearch in near-real time
radar.signal: Livrer des logs CloudWatch vers OpenSearch en quasi temps reel, sans code -> Kinesis Data Firehose (source = log group, destination = OpenSearch)

pieges.A: L'abonnement direct CloudWatch->OpenSearch deploie une Lambda a gerer et scale moins bien
pieges.B: Une Lambda custom = du code a ecrire et maintenir
pieges.D: Kinesis Agent sur chaque serveur + Data Streams = beaucoup de composants a operer

explication: Kinesis Data Firehose est un service de livraison entierement manage : en configurant le log group CloudWatch comme source et OpenSearch comme destination, les logs sont diffuses en quasi temps reel sans code ni serveur, avec mise a l'echelle automatique. C'est le plus faible overhead.

question: A gaming company is designing a highly available architecture. The application runs on a modified Linux kernel and supports only UDP-based traffic. The company needs the front-end tier to provide the best possible user experience. That tier must have low latency, route traffic to the nearest edge location, and provide static IP addresses for entry into the application endpoints. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Route 53 to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in AWS Application Auto Scaling.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in an AWS Application Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Configure AWS Global Accelerator to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Configure Amazon API Gateway to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.

radar.signal: UDP + IP statiques + routage edge faible latence + kernel custom -> AWS Global Accelerator + Network Load Balancer + EC2 Auto Scaling

pieges.A: Route 53 + ALB ne fournit ni IP statiques ni support UDP ; Lambda ne supporte pas un kernel modifie
pieges.B: CloudFront est fait pour HTTP(S), pas pour l'UDP ; Lambda idem
pieges.D: API Gateway + ALB ne gere pas l'UDP ni les IP statiques d'entree

explication: AWS Global Accelerator fournit des adresses IP statiques d'entree et route le trafic via le reseau edge d'AWS pour une faible latence, tout en supportant l'UDP via un Network Load Balancer. L'application sur kernel Linux modifie tourne sur des EC2 en Auto Scaling (Lambda ne le permettrait pas).

question: A company wants to migrate its existing on-premises monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to keep as much of the front-end code and the backend code as possible. However, the company wants to break the application into smaller applications. A different team will manage each application. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway.
options.B: Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda.
options.C: Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as targets.
options.D: Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the target.

radar.signal: Decouper un monolithe en microservices en conservant le code -> conteneurs sur Amazon ECS + Application Load Balancer

pieges.A: Lambda imposerait de refondre le code en fonctions (on veut le conserver)
pieges.B: Amplify + API Gateway + Lambda = refonte serverless, pas la reprise du code monolithe
pieges.C: EC2 + ALB laisse des serveurs a gerer et ne facilite pas le decoupage par equipe

explication: La conteneurisation sur Amazon ECS permet de reprendre l'essentiel du code existant tout en decoupant le monolithe en services distincts, chacun gere par une equipe, derriere un Application Load Balancer. C'est scalable et moins operationnel qu'EC2, sans la refonte qu'imposerait Lambda.

question: A company has an on-premises application that generates a large amount of time-sensitive data that is backed up to Amazon S3. The application has grown and there are user complaints about internet bandwidth limitations. A solutions architect needs to design a long-term solution that allows for both timely backups to Amazon S3 and with minimal impact on internet connectivity for internal users. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Establish AWS VPN connections and proxy all traffic through a VPC gateway endpoint.
options.B: Establish a new AWS Direct Connect connection and direct backup traffic through this new connection.
options.C: Order daily AWS Snowball devices. Load the data onto the Snowball devices and return the devices to AWS each day.
options.D: Submit a support ticket through the AWS Management Console. Request the removal of S3 service limits from the account.

declencheurs: time-sensitive data backed up to S3
timely backups + minimal impact on internal users
radar.signal: Deporter le trafic de backup hors du lien Internet partage -> une connexion AWS Direct Connect dediee pour le backup

pieges.A: Un VPN passe toujours par le lien Internet (n'allege pas la bande passante)
pieges.C: Snowball quotidien n'est pas 'timely' et est lourd a operer au long cours
pieges.D: Relever des limites S3 ne change rien a la bande passante Internet

explication: Une connexion Direct Connect dediee offre une liaison privee a debit stable pour le trafic de backup vers S3, sans consommer la bande passante Internet des utilisateurs internes. Un VPN emprunterait le meme lien Internet, et Snowball ne permet pas des backups reguliers et rapides.

question: A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains critical data. The company must protect the data from accidental deletion. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket.
options.B: Enable MFA Delete on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket.
options.D: Enable default encryption on the S3 bucket.
options.E: Create a lifecycle policy for the objects in the S3 bucket.

declencheurs: protect S3 data from accidental deletion
radar.signal: Empecher les suppressions accidentelles S3 -> activer le versioning (A) + activer MFA Delete (B)

pieges.C: Une bucket policy peut aider mais n'est pas le mecanisme cible contre la suppression accidentelle
pieges.D: Le chiffrement par defaut protege la confidentialite, pas contre la suppression
pieges.E: Une lifecycle policy peut au contraire supprimer/expirer des objets

explication: Le versioning conserve les versions anterieures, si bien qu'une suppression cree un delete marker recuperable (A). MFA Delete exige un code MFA pour supprimer definitivement une version ou desactiver le versioning (B). Ensemble, ils protegent efficacement contre les suppressions accidentelles.

question: A company runs its critical storage application in the AWS Cloud. The application uses Amazon S3 in two AWS Regions. The company wants the application to send remote user data to the nearest S3 bucket with no public network congestion. The company also wants the application to fail over with the least amount of management of Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an active-active design between the two Regions. Configure the application to use the regional S3 endpoints closest to the user.
options.B: Use an active-passive configuration with S3 Multi-Region Access Points. Create a global endpoint for each of the Regions.
options.C: Send user data to the regional S3 endpoints closest to the user. Configure an S3 cross-account replication rule to keep the S3 buckets synchronized.
options.D: Set up Amazon S3 to use Multi-Region Access Points in an active-active configuration with a single global endpoint. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication.

declencheurs: fail over with least S3 management
radar.signal: Endpoint global unique routant vers le bucket le plus proche + bascule manageee -> S3 Multi-Region Access Points en actif-actif + S3 Cross-Region Replication

pieges.A: Un design actif-actif avec endpoints regionaux gere a la main les bascules et le routage
pieges.B: Actif-passif + 'un endpoint global par Region' n'est pas le fonctionnement d'un MRAP (endpoint global unique)
pieges.C: La replication cross-account + routage manuel = plus de gestion

explication: Un S3 Multi-Region Access Point offre un endpoint global unique qui achemine chaque utilisateur vers le bucket regional le plus proche via le reseau AWS (sans congestion Internet) et gere la bascule automatiquement. La Cross-Region Replication garde les buckets synchronises, minimisant la gestion cote S3.

question: A company is migrating a data center from its on-premises location to AWS. The company has several legacy applications that are hosted on individual virtual servers. Changes to the application designs cannot be made. Each individual virtual server currently runs as its own EC2 instance. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the applications are reliable and fault tolerant after migration to AWS. The applications will run on Amazon EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a minimum of one and a maximum of one. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Use the AMI to create EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group. Configure an Application Load Balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Use AWS Backup to create an hourly backup of the EC2 instance that hosts each application. Store the backup in Amazon S3 in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a disaster recovery process to restore the EC2 instance for each application from its most recent backup.
options.C: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Launch two new EC2 instances from the AMI. Place each EC2 instance in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a Network Load Balancer that has the EC2 instances as targets.
options.D: Use AWS Migration Hub Refactor Spaces to migrate each application off the EC2 instance. Break down functionality from each application into individual components. Host each application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type.

declencheurs: reliable and fault tolerant after migration
radar.signal: Rendre chaque app tolerante aux pannes sans changer le code -> AMI de l'instance + deux EC2 dans deux AZ + Network Load Balancer

pieges.A: Un Auto Scaling group min=1/max=1 = une seule instance, pas tolerant aux pannes d'AZ
pieges.B: AWS Backup + restauration = reprise apres sinistre, pas de la tolerance active aux pannes
pieges.D: Refactor Spaces + ECS = refonte en composants, or les designs ne peuvent pas changer

explication: Sans modifier les applications, on cree une AMI de chaque instance et on lance deux copies dans deux AZ distinctes, derriere un Network Load Balancer. Si une AZ ou une instance tombe, l'autre continue de servir : c'est une architecture reellement tolerante aux pannes, contrairement a un ASG min/max=1 (instance unique).

question: A company needs to minimize the cost of its 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection. The company's average connection utilization is less than 10%. A solutions architect must recommend a solution that will reduce the cost without compromising security. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up a new 1 Gbps Direct Connect connection. Share the connection with another AWS account.
options.B: Set up a new 200 Mbps Direct Connect connection in the AWS Management Console.
options.C: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 1 Gbps connection. Share the connection with another AWS account.
options.D: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 200 Mbps hosted connection for an existing AWS account.

radar.signal: Reduire la capacite/le cout d'un DX sous-utilise -> une hosted connection de 200 Mbps commandee via un partenaire Direct Connect

pieges.A: Repartir un 1 Gbps entre comptes ne reduit pas le cout de base et complique la securite
pieges.C: Une connexion 1 Gbps partagee ne reduit pas la depense
pieges.B: On ne commande pas une connexion DEDIEE de 200 Mbps dans la console (dediee = 1/10/100 Gbps uniquement)

alerte_cle: La cle du fichier indique B, mais une connexion Direct Connect de 200 Mbps est une hosted connection commandee aupres d'un partenaire (les connexions dediees dans la console ne font que 1/10/100 Gbps). La bonne reponse est D.
explication: Comme le lien 1 Gbps est utilise a moins de 10 %, passer a 200 Mbps reduit le cout. Or les capacites inferieures a 1 Gbps ne sont disponibles que sous forme de hosted connections, commandees via un AWS Direct Connect Partner (option D), et non en connexion dediee depuis la console (option B). La securite d'une liaison privee dediee reste preservee.

question: A company has multiple Windows file servers on premises. The company wants to migrate and consolidate its files into an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. File permissions must be preserved to ensure that access rights do not change. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy AWS DataSync agents on premises. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.B: Copy the shares on each file server into Amazon S3 buckets by using the AWS CLI. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.C: Remove the drives from each file server. Ship the drives to AWS for import into Amazon S3. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.D: Order an AWS Snowcone device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Launch AWS DataSync agents on the device. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.E: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Copy data to the device by using the AWS CLI. Ship the device back to AWS for import into Amazon S3. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.

declencheurs: consolidate Windows file servers to FSx for Windows
radar.signal: Migrer vers FSx for Windows en preservant les ACL -> DataSync (qui preserve les ACL SMB) via agents on-prem (A) ou via une appliance Snowcone avec agents DataSync (D)

pieges.B: Passer par S3 (CLI puis DataSync) perd les ACL NTFS
pieges.C: Import de disques vers S3 perd egalement les permissions
pieges.E: Snowball Edge -> S3 -> DataSync perd les ACL en transitant par S3

explication: AWS DataSync transfere directement vers FSx for Windows File Server en preservant les permissions/ACL SMB. On deploie soit des agents DataSync on-prem (A), soit une appliance Snowcone executant des agents DataSync pour les sites a faible bande passante (D). Toute route passant par S3 (B, C, E) perdrait les ACL NTFS.

question: A company has two VPCs named Management and Production. The Management VPC uses VPNs through a customer gateway to connect to a single device in the data center. The Production VPC uses a virtual private gateway with two attached AWS Direct Connect connections. The Management and Production VPCs both use a single VPC peering connection to allow communication between the applications. What should a solutions architect do to mitigate any single point of failure in this architecture?

options.A: Add a set of VPNs between the Management and Production VPCs.
options.B: Add a second virtual private gateway and attach it to the Management VPC.
options.C: Add a second set of VPNs to the Management VPC from a second customer gateway device.
options.D: Add a second VPC peering connection between the Management VPC and the Production VPC.

declencheurs: Management VPC uses VPN through a SINGLE customer gateway device
radar.signal: Le point unique de defaillance est l'unique appareil customer gateway du VPC Management -> ajouter un second jeu de VPN depuis un second customer gateway

pieges.A: Des VPN entre les deux VPC ne corrigent pas le SPOF cote data center
pieges.B: Un second virtual private gateway concerne le cote AWS, pas l'appareil unique on-prem
pieges.D: Une seconde connexion de peering ne traite pas le SPOF du customer gateway

explication: Le seul point de defaillance non redonde est l'unique appareil customer gateway par lequel le VPC Management etablit ses VPN. Ajouter un second jeu de tunnels VPN depuis un second appareil customer gateway elimine ce SPOF cote data center.

question: A company runs its application on an Oracle database. The company plans to quickly migrate to AWS because of limited resources for the database, backup administration, and data center maintenance. The application uses third-party database features that require privileged access. Which solution will help the company migrate the database to AWS MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Replace third-party features with cloud services.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) for Oracle. Customize the database settings to support third-party features.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL by rewriting the application code to remove dependency on Oracle APEX.

radar.signal: Fonctions tierces exigeant un acces privilegie (impossible sur RDS standard) au meilleur cout -> Oracle sur EC2 (AMI) avec parametrage personnalise

pieges.A: RDS for Oracle n'autorise pas l'acces privilegie requis par les fonctions tierces
pieges.B: RDS Custom for Oracle autorise l'acces privilegie mais coute plus cher qu'EC2
pieges.D: Reecrire l'app pour PostgreSQL contredit la migration rapide

explication: Les fonctionnalites tierces exigeant un acces privilegie ne sont pas possibles sur RDS for Oracle. Oracle sur EC2 (via une AMI) donne le controle complet requis, tout en sortant du data center (fin de la maintenance sur site), et reste plus economique que RDS Custom for Oracle. Nuance : RDS Custom (B) est l'alternative manageee si l'on privilegie moins d'administration au prix d'un cout superieur.

question: A social media company has workloads that collect and process data. The workloads store the data in on-premises NFS storage. The data store cannot scale fast enough to meet the company's expanding business needs. The company wants to migrate the current data store to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class.
options.B: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class.
options.C: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy.
options.D: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy.

radar.signal: Remplacer un stockage NFS on-prem par du stockage AWS peu couteux avec cycles de vie -> S3 File Gateway + Lifecycle vers la classe S3 adaptee

pieges.A: Volume Gateway = block iSCSI, pas un remplacement NFS
pieges.C: EFS Standard-IA est plus cher que du stockage adosse a S3
pieges.D: EFS One Zone-IA est moins durable et reste plus cher que S3

explication: Un S3 File Gateway presente une interface de fichiers tout en stockant les donnees dans S3, ou une Lifecycle policy les bascule vers des classes moins cheres selon l'usage. C'est plus economique qu'EFS pour ce cas. Le Volume Gateway est du block iSCSI, pas un equivalent NFS.

question: A company uses high concurrency AWS Lambda functions to process a constantly increasing number of messages in a message queue during marketing events. The Lambda functions use CPU intensive code to process the messages. The company wants to reduce the compute costs and to maintain service latency for its customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions.
options.B: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.
options.C: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions.
options.D: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.

radar.signal: Reduire le cout d'un traitement CPU-intensif Lambda tout en gardant la latence -> provisioned concurrency + augmenter la memoire selon Compute Optimizer

pieges.A: Reduced concurrency + moins de memoire = plus lent (la puissance CPU depend de la memoire)
pieges.B: La reserved concurrency plafonne la concurrence, elle ne pre-chauffe pas pour la latence
pieges.C: Diminuer la memoire reduit le CPU alloue et degrade le temps de traitement

explication: Dans Lambda, le CPU alloue croit avec la memoire : pour du code CPU-intensif, augmenter la memoire (selon les recommandations de Compute Optimizer) reduit la duree d'execution, donc souvent le cout total, tout en accelerant le traitement. La provisioned concurrency maintient des environnements prets pour preserver la latence pendant les pics.

question: A company is building a new web-based customer relationship management application. The application will use several Amazon EC2 instances that are backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application will also use an Amazon Aurora database. All data for the application must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) certificates on the ALB to encrypt data in transit. Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest.
options.B: Use the AWS root account to log in to the AWS Management Console. Upload the company encryption certificates. While in the root account, select the option to turn on encryption for all data at rest and in transit for the account.
options.C: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest. Attach an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.
options.D: Use BitLocker to encrypt all data at rest. Import the company TLS certificate keys to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Attach the KMS keys to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.

declencheurs: encrypt at rest AND in transit
radar.signal: Chiffrement au repos (EBS/Aurora) -> AWS KMS ; chiffrement en transit -> certificat ACM sur l'ALB

pieges.A: ACM ne chiffre pas des volumes/stockage au repos, et KMS ne fournit pas de certificats a l'ALB
pieges.B: Il n'existe pas d'option 'tout chiffrer' au niveau du compte via le root
pieges.D: BitLocker est une solution OS non manageee ; on n'attache pas des cles KMS a un ALB pour le TLS

explication: Le chiffrement au repos des volumes EBS et du stockage Aurora se fait avec des cles AWS KMS. Le chiffrement en transit se realise en attachant un certificat ACM au listener HTTPS de l'ALB. Chaque service est utilise pour son role : KMS pour le repos, ACM pour le TLS.

question: A company is moving its on-premises Oracle database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The database has several applications that write to the same tables. The applications need to be migrated one by one with a month in between each migration. Management has expressed concerns that the database has a high number of reads and writes. The data must be kept in sync across both databases throughout the migration. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.C: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a memory optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.D: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a compute optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select the largest tables.

declencheurs: apps migrated one by one over months
radar.signal: Migration heterogene + synchro continue sous forte charge -> AWS SCT + DMS sur une instance de replication memory optimized, tache full load + CDC sur toutes les tables

pieges.A: DataSync sert aux fichiers, pas a une migration de base ; CDC seul n'assure pas le chargement initial
pieges.B: DataSync n'est pas adapte a une base de donnees
pieges.D: Une instance compute optimized et un mapping limite aux plus grandes tables ne conviennent pas a une forte charge et a toutes les tables

explication: Passer d'Oracle a Aurora PostgreSQL est une migration heterogene : AWS SCT convertit le schema et DMS transfere les donnees. Une tache full load + CDC realise le chargement initial puis synchronise les changements en continu pendant les mois de migration. Une instance de replication memory optimized encaisse le fort volume de lectures/ecritures.

question: A company has a web application hosted over 10 Amazon EC2 instances with traffic directed by Amazon Route 53. The company occasionally experiences a timeout error when attempting to browse the application. The networking team finds that some DNS queries return IP addresses of unhealthy instances, resulting in the timeout error. What should a solutions architect implement to overcome these timeout errors?

options.A: Create a Route 53 simple routing policy record for each EC2 instance. Associate a health check with each record.
options.B: Create a Route 53 failover routing policy record for each EC2 instance. Associate a health check with each record.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with EC2 instances as its origin. Associate a health check with the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a health check in front of the EC2 instances. Route to the ALB from Route 53.

declencheurs: Route 53 returns IPs of unhealthy instances
radar.signal: Ne plus router vers des instances defaillantes -> Application Load Balancer avec health checks devant les EC2, Route 53 pointe vers l'ALB

pieges.A: Une simple routing policy ne fait pas de bascule sur health check de facon fiable pour 10 instances
pieges.B: Une failover policy par instance est lourde et inadaptee a un pool d'instances actives
pieges.C: CloudFront est un CDN, il ne resout pas la repartition/sante entre 10 EC2

explication: En placant un Application Load Balancer avec health checks devant les instances et en faisant pointer Route 53 vers l'ALB, seul le trafic vers des cibles saines est achemine. L'ALB retire automatiquement les instances defaillantes, ce qui elimine les timeouts causes par des IP d'instances en panne.

question: A solutions architect needs to design a highly available application consisting of web, application, and database tiers. HTTPS content delivery should be as close to the edge as possible, with the least delivery time. Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST secure?

options.A: Configure a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the public ALB as the origin.
options.B: Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.
options.C: Configure a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the public ALB as the origin.
options.D: Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.

declencheurs: HTTPS at the edge, least delivery time
radar.signal: Contenu HTTPS au bord + securite maximale -> CloudFront avec ALB public en origine, EC2 dans des subnets PRIVES

pieges.A: EC2 dans des subnets publics = surface d'exposition inutile (moins securise)
pieges.B: Utiliser les EC2 comme origine (au lieu de l'ALB) contourne le point d'entree gere
pieges.D: EC2 publics + origine EC2 = le moins securise

explication: CloudFront diffuse le HTTPS au plus pres des utilisateurs, avec l'ALB public comme origine. Placer les EC2 dans des subnets prives (joignables uniquement via l'ALB) reduit la surface d'attaque : c'est la configuration la plus securisee parmi les options.

question: A company runs an ecommerce application on AWS. Amazon EC2 instances process purchases and store the purchase details in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. Customers are experiencing application timeouts during times of peak usage. A solutions architect needs to rearchitect the application so that the application can scale to meet peak usage demands. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances to retry the purchases until the processing is complete. Update the applications to connect to the DB cluster by using Amazon RDS Proxy.
options.B: Configure the application to use an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of the Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.C: Update the application to send the purchase requests to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances that read from the SQS queue.
options.D: Configure an AWS Lambda function to retry the ticket purchases until the processing is complete.
options.E: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a usage plan.

radar.signal: Decoupler et lisser les pics + proteger la base -> file SQS + ASG consommant la file (C) ; ASG avec reprise + RDS Proxy pour le pooling de connexions (A)

pieges.B: ElastiCache accelere les lectures mais ne resout pas la saturation d'ecriture/traitement des achats
pieges.D: Une Lambda de retry ne remplace pas le decouplage par file ni le pooling
pieges.E: Un usage plan API Gateway limite le debit, il ne fait pas scaler le traitement

explication: Envoyer les achats dans une file SQS decouple la reception du traitement et absorbe les pics ; un Auto Scaling group consomme la file au rythme adapte (C). En parallele, connecter l'application a Aurora via RDS Proxy mutualise les connexions et evite l'epuisement du pool pendant les pointes (A). Ensemble, la solution scale a moindre cout.

question: A company that uses AWS Organizations runs 150 applications across 30 different AWS accounts. The company used AWS Cost and Usage Report to create a new report in the management account. The report is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is replicated to a bucket in the data collection account. The company senior leadership wants to view a custom dashboard that provides NAT gateway costs each day starting at the beginning of the current month. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.B: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.
options.C: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.D: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.

declencheurs: Cost and Usage Report in S3
radar.signal: Tableau de bord custom sur le CUR stocke dans S3 -> Amazon QuickSight alimente par Amazon Athena (qui interroge le CUR)

pieges.A: DataSync transfere des donnees, il n'interroge pas le rapport
pieges.C: CloudWatch dashboards visualisent des metriques, pas un CUR dans S3
pieges.D: CloudWatch ne s'interroge pas via Athena sur un CUR

explication: Le Cost and Usage Report reside dans S3 : Amazon Athena l'interroge en SQL, et Amazon QuickSight construit le tableau de bord custom (visuel en table des couts NAT gateway par jour). CloudWatch sert aux metriques operationnelles, pas a interroger un CUR, et DataSync ne fait que du transfert.

question: A company runs an application on a group of Amazon Linux EC2 instances. For compliance reasons, the company must retain all application log files for 7 years. The log files will be analyzed by a reporting tool that must be able to access all the files concurrently. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store
options.D: Amazon S3

declencheurs: reporting tool accesses all files concurrently
radar.signal: Stockage durable, peu couteux, acces concurrent a de nombreux fichiers -> Amazon S3

pieges.A: EBS est attache a une instance, pas fait pour un acces concurrent large et un archivage 7 ans
pieges.B: EFS est plus cher que S3 pour de l'archivage longue duree
pieges.C: L'instance store est ephemere (perte a l'arret)

explication: Amazon S3 offre un stockage tres durable et economique, ideal pour conserver des logs pendant 7 ans, et permet a l'outil de reporting d'acceder a tous les fichiers en parallele via l'API. EBS et l'instance store sont lies a des instances, et EFS coute plus cher pour de l'archivage.

question: A company has hired an external vendor to perform work in the company's AWS account. The vendor uses an automated tool that is hosted in an AWS account that the vendor owns. The vendor does not have IAM access to the company's AWS account. How should a solutions architect grant this access to the vendor?

options.A: Create an IAM role in the company's account to delegate access to the vendor's IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.B: Create an IAM user in the company account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.C: Create an IAM group in the company account. Add the tool's IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.D: Create a new identity provider by choosing "AWS account" as the provider type in the IAM console. Supply the vendor's AWS account ID and user name. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the new provider for the permissions that the vendor requires.

declencheurs: external vendor tool in vendor's own AWS account
no IAM access to company account
radar.signal: Acces cross-account depuis le compte du prestataire -> role IAM dans le compte de l'entreprise deleguant l'acces au role IAM du prestataire

pieges.B: Creer un IAM user avec mot de passe = identifiants a gerer, pas le modele cross-account
pieges.C: On ne peut pas ajouter l'IAM user d'un autre compte a un groupe local
pieges.D: 'AWS account' n'est pas un type de fournisseur d'identite pour ce besoin

explication: Le modele cross-account consiste a creer un role IAM dans le compte de l'entreprise, avec une relation de confiance vers le role/compte du prestataire, et a y attacher les permissions necessaires. L'outil du prestataire assume ce role, sans qu'on cree d'utilisateur ni de cles a gerer.

question: A company runs a web application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances in the private subnet of a VPC. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) that extends across the public subnets directs web traffic to the EC2 instances. The company wants to implement new security measures to restrict inbound traffic from the ALB to the EC2 instances while preventing access from any other source inside or outside the private subnet of the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a route in a route table to direct traffic from the internet to the private IP addresses of the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances to only allow traffic that comes from the security group for the ALB.
options.C: Move the EC2 instances into the public subnet. Give the EC2 instances a set of Elastic IP addresses.
options.D: Configure the security group for the ALB to allow any TCP traffic on any port.

declencheurs: restrict inbound from ALB to EC2 only
radar.signal: N'autoriser que le trafic de l'ALB vers les EC2 -> SG des EC2 autorisant uniquement le SG de l'ALB comme source

pieges.A: Router Internet vers les IP privees exposerait les instances (contraire au besoin)
pieges.C: Deplacer les EC2 en subnet public + Elastic IP les expose
pieges.D: Ouvrir tout le TCP sur l'ALB ne restreint rien

explication: En configurant le security group des EC2 pour n'accepter que le trafic provenant du security group de l'ALB (reference de SG a SG), seules les requetes passant par l'ALB atteignent les instances. Toute autre source, interne ou externe, est bloquee, ce qui applique exactement la restriction demandee.

question: A research company runs experiments that are powered by a simulation application and a visualization application. The simulation application runs on Linux and outputs intermediate data to an NFS share every 5 minutes. The visualization application is a Windows desktop application that displays the simulation output and requires an SMB file system. The company maintains two synchronized file systems. This strategy is causing data duplication and inefficient resource usage. The company needs to migrate the applications to AWS without making code changes to either application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate both applications to AWS Lambda. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to exchange data between the applications.
options.B: Migrate both applications to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon FSx File Gateway for storage.
options.C: Migrate the simulation application to Linux Amazon EC2 instances. Migrate the visualization application to Windows EC2 instances. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to exchange data between the applications.
options.D: Migrate the simulation application to Linux Amazon EC2 instances. Migrate the visualization application to Windows EC2 instances. Configure Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for storage.

radar.signal: Un seul stockage multi-protocole NFS + SMB sans changer le code -> Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

pieges.A: Lambda + S3 imposerait des changements de code et n'offre pas NFS/SMB natifs
pieges.B: FSx File Gateway est une passerelle on-prem, pas un stockage partage multi-protocole cible
pieges.C: SQS echange des messages, il ne fournit pas un systeme de fichiers partage

explication: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP expose le meme volume a la fois en NFS (pour l'application Linux de simulation) et en SMB (pour l'application Windows de visualisation). Un stockage unique multi-protocole supprime la duplication et la synchronisation, sans modifier le code des applications.

question: A company order system sends requests from clients to Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances process the orders and then store the orders in a database on Amazon RDS. Users report that they must reprocess orders when the system fails. The company wants a resilient solution that can process orders automatically if a system outage occurs. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to target an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task.
options.B: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Update the order system to send messages to the ALB endpoint.
options.C: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Configure the order system to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the EC2 instances to consume messages from the queue.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function, and subscribe the function to the SNS topic. Configure the order system to send messages to the SNS topic. Send a command to the EC2 instances to process the messages by using AWS Systems Manager Run Command.

radar.signal: Ne pas perdre/reprocesser les commandes en cas de panne -> decoupler via une file SQS ; un ASG d'EC2 consomme les messages

pieges.A: EventBridge -> ECS ne conserve pas les commandes en attente comme une file durable
pieges.B: Un ALB repartit le trafic mais ne tamponne pas les requetes en cas de panne
pieges.D: SNS ne conserve pas les messages non delivres (pas de tampon durable)

explication: En envoyant les commandes dans une file SQS, elles sont conservees de facon durable meme si les instances tombent. Un Auto Scaling group d'EC2 consomme la file et reprend le traitement automatiquement apres une panne, sans que les utilisateurs aient a re-soumettre les commandes.

question: A company runs an application on a large fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads and writes entries into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The size of the DynamoDB table continuously grows, but the application needs only data from the last 30 days. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and development effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the complete solution. Redeploy the CloudFormation stack every 30 days, and delete the original stack.
options.B: Use an EC2 instance that runs a monitoring application from AWS Marketplace. Configure the monitoring application to use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to store the timestamp when a new item is created in the table. Use a script that runs on the EC2 instance to delete items that have a timestamp that is older than 30 days.
options.C: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function when a new item is created in the table. Configure the Lambda function to delete items in the table that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Extend the application to add an attribute that has a value of the current timestamp plus 30 days to each new item that is created in the table. Configure DynamoDB to use the attribute as the TTL attribute.

radar.signal: Purger automatiquement les vieux items DynamoDB sans code -> attribut TTL (timestamp + 30 jours) et TTL active sur la table

pieges.A: Redeployer une stack CloudFormation tous les 30 jours = fragile et destructif
pieges.B: Un EC2 de monitoring + script = infrastructure et code a maintenir
pieges.C: Une Lambda declenchee par Streams pour supprimer = plus de code que le TTL natif

explication: DynamoDB TTL supprime automatiquement et gratuitement les items dont l'attribut d'horodatage est depasse. En ecrivant sur chaque item un attribut valant 'maintenant + 30 jours' et en le designant comme attribut TTL, les donnees de plus de 30 jours sont purgees sans code ni infrastructure.

question: A company has applications hosted on Amazon EC2 instances with IPv6 addresses. The applications must initiate communications with other external applications using the internet. However, the company's security policy states that any external service cannot initiate a connection to the EC2 instances. What should a solutions architect recommend to resolve this issue?

options.A: Create a NAT gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table.
options.B: Create an internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table.
options.C: Create a virtual private gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table.
options.D: Create an egress-only internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table.

declencheurs: external services cannot initiate connections to EC2
radar.signal: Sortie Internet IPv6 uniquement sortante -> egress-only internet gateway

pieges.A: Un NAT gateway concerne l'IPv4, pas l'IPv6
pieges.B: Un internet gateway permet aussi les connexions entrantes (interdit ici)
pieges.C: Un virtual private gateway sert au VPN, pas a la sortie Internet
