explication: L'egress-only internet gateway est l'equivalent IPv6 du NAT : il autorise les connexions sortantes initiees par les instances vers Internet, tout en empechant tout service externe d'initier une connexion vers les EC2, ce qui respecte la politique de securite.

question: A company is creating an application that runs on containers in a VPC. The application stores and accesses data in an Amazon S3 bucket. During the development phase, the application will store and access 1 TB of data in Amazon S3 each day. The company wants to minimize costs and wants to prevent traffic from traversing the internet whenever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable S3 Intelligent-Tiering for the S3 bucket.
options.B: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration for the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC.
options.D: Create an interface endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC.

radar.signal: Acces S3 prive et economique depuis un VPC -> gateway VPC endpoint pour S3, associe aux route tables

pieges.A: Intelligent-Tiering optimise le stockage, pas le chemin reseau/cout de transfert
pieges.B: Transfer Acceleration passe par Internet et facture un supplement
pieges.D: Un interface endpoint pour S3 est facture a l'heure et au Go (plus cher que le gateway endpoint)

explication: Le gateway VPC endpoint pour S3 est gratuit et route le trafic vers S3 par le reseau AWS, sans Internet ni frais de transfert. Associe a toutes les route tables du VPC, il permet aux conteneurs d'echanger 1 To/jour avec S3 a moindre cout et de facon privee.

question: A solutions architect is implementing a complex Java application with a MySQL database. The Java application must be deployed on Apache Tomcat and must be highly available. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application in AWS Lambda. Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to connect with the Lambda functions.
options.B: Deploy the application by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Configure a load-balanced environment and a rolling deployment policy.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon ElastiCache. Configure the ElastiCache security group to allow access from the application.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Install a MySQL server on the EC2 instance. Configure the application on the server. Create an AMI. Use the AMI to create a launch template with an Auto Scaling group.

radar.signal: Deployer une app Java/Tomcat en HA sans gerer l'infra -> AWS Elastic Beanstalk, environnement load-balanced + deploiement rolling

pieges.A: Lambda + API Gateway ne convient pas a une app Tomcat existante
pieges.C: ElastiCache est un cache, pas un remplacement de la base MySQL
pieges.D: Construire soi-meme AMI + launch template + ASG = beaucoup plus d'effort qu'Elastic Beanstalk

explication: AWS Elastic Beanstalk supporte nativement les applications Java sur Tomcat et provisionne un environnement load-balanced multi-AZ hautement disponible, avec des deploiements rolling. Il gere l'infrastructure sous-jacente, evitant de construire manuellement AMI, launch template et Auto Scaling group.

question: A serverless application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. The Lambda function needs permissions to read and write to the DynamoDB table. Which solution will give the Lambda function access to the DynamoDB table MOST securely?

options.A: Create an IAM user with programmatic access to the Lambda function. Attach a policy to the user that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Store the access-key-id and secret-access-key parameters as part of the Lambda environment variables. Ensure that other AWS users do not have read and write access to the Lambda function configuration.
options.B: Create an IAM role that includes Lambda as a trusted service. Attach a policy to the role that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the new role as the execution role.
options.C: Create an IAM user with programmatic access to the Lambda function. Attach a policy to the user that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Store the access-key-id and secret-access-key parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Update the Lambda function code to retrieve the secure string parameters before connecting to the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Create an IAM role that includes DynamoDB as a trusted service. Attach a policy to the role that allows read and write access from the Lambda function. Update the code of the Lambda function to attach to the new role as an execution role.

radar.signal: Donner a Lambda l'acces a DynamoDB de facon sure -> role IAM avec Lambda comme service de confiance, defini comme execution role

pieges.A: Cles d'acces dans des variables d'environnement = secrets a gerer (mauvaise pratique)
pieges.C: Cles dans Parameter Store restent des cles statiques a manipuler dans le code
pieges.D: Le service de confiance doit etre Lambda (pas DynamoDB) pour un execution role

explication: La maniere la plus sure est un role IAM d'execution dont la relation de confiance autorise le service Lambda, avec une policy accordant l'acces a la table DynamoDB. La fonction obtient des identifiants temporaires automatiquement, sans aucune cle statique en dur ou dans le code.

question: A solutions architect is designing a REST API in Amazon API Gateway for a cash payback service. The application requires 1 GB of memory and 2 GB of storage for its computation resources. The application will require that the data is in a relational format. Which additional combination of AWS services will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Amazon EC2
options.B: AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon RDS
options.D: Amazon DynamoDB
options.E: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS)

radar.signal: Compute serverless leger + base relationnelle manageee -> AWS Lambda + Amazon RDS

pieges.A: EC2 = serveurs a gerer (plus d'administration)
pieges.D: DynamoDB est NoSQL, or le besoin est relationnel
pieges.E: EKS = orchestration Kubernetes a operer, tres administratif

explication: Pour du calcul leger (1 Go de memoire) derriere API Gateway avec le moins d'administration, AWS Lambda est ideal (serverless). Le besoin de donnees relationnelles impose Amazon RDS (manage), plutot que DynamoDB (NoSQL). EC2 et EKS ajouteraient de la gestion d'infrastructure.

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to run workloads within multiple AWS accounts. A tagging policy adds department tags to AWS resources when the company creates tags. An accounting team needs to determine spending on Amazon EC2 consumption. The accounting team must determine which departments are responsible for the costs regardless of AWS account. The accounting team has access to AWS Cost Explorer for all AWS accounts within the organization and needs to access all reports from Cost Explorer. Which solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.B: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.C: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by the tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.D: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.

declencheurs: EC2 spending per department across accounts
radar.signal: Ventiler le cout EC2 par departement -> activer le cost allocation tag user-defined 'department' depuis le compte de gestion + rapport Cost Explorer groupe par tag, filtre EC2

pieges.B: Le tag 'department' est defini par l'entreprise (user-defined), pas AWS-defined
pieges.C: L'activation des cost allocation tags se fait dans le compte de GESTION, pas un compte membre
pieges.D: Compte membre + tag AWS-defined = doublement faux

explication: Le tag 'department' etant cree par l'entreprise, c'est un cost allocation tag user-defined, active depuis la console de facturation du compte de gestion de l'organisation. Un unique rapport Cost Explorer groupe par ce tag et filtre sur EC2 donne la depense par departement, tous comptes confondus.

question: A company is developing a microservices application that will provide a search catalog for customers. The company must use REST APIs to present the frontend of the application to users. The REST APIs must access the backend services that the company hosts in containers in private VPC subnets. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Design a WebSocket API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a private VPC link for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.B: Design a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a private VPC link for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.C: Design a WebSocket API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a security group for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.D: Design a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a security group for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.

declencheurs: backend containers in private VPC subnets
API Gateway access to private ECS
radar.signal: REST API exposee + acces prive a des conteneurs -> REST API API Gateway + private VPC link vers ECS en subnet prive

pieges.A: Une WebSocket API ne correspond pas a des REST APIs demandees
pieges.C: WebSocket + security group : mauvais type d'API et mauvais mecanisme d'acces prive
pieges.D: Un security group ne relie pas API Gateway a un service prive ; il faut un VPC link

explication: Le besoin de REST APIs impose une REST API API Gateway. Pour atteindre des conteneurs ECS dans des subnets prives, on cree un private VPC link (via un NLB) : API Gateway y accede sans exposer les services sur Internet. Une WebSocket API ou un simple security group ne repondent pas au besoin.

question: A company stores raw collected data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is used for several types of analytics on behalf of the company's customers. The type of analytics requested determines the access pattern on the S3 objects. The company cannot predict or control the access pattern. The company wants to reduce its S3 costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use S3 replication to transition infrequently accessed objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.B: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.C: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.D: Use S3 Inventory to identify and transition objects that have not been accessed from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering.

radar.signal: Optimiser les couts S3 sans connaitre le pattern d'acces -> Lifecycle vers S3 Intelligent-Tiering

pieges.A: S3 replication ne 'transitionne' pas vers Standard-IA (mauvais mecanisme)
pieges.B: Standard-IA suppose un acces peu frequent connu ; ici le pattern est imprevisible (risque de frais de recuperation)
pieges.D: S3 Inventory + transition manuelle = plus d'effort et pas adaptatif

explication: S3 Intelligent-Tiering deplace automatiquement les objets entre paliers d'acces selon leur usage reel, sans frais de recuperation, ce qui est ideal quand le pattern d'acces est imprevisible. Une transition fixe vers Standard-IA risquerait des frais de recuperation si les objets sont finalement souvent lus.

question: A company is migrating an application from on-premises servers to Amazon EC2 instances. As part of the migration design requirements, a solutions architect must implement infrastructure metric alarms. The company does not need to take action if CPU utilization increases to more than 50% for a short burst of time. However, if the CPU utilization increases to more than 50% and read IOPS on the disk are high at the same time, the company needs to act as soon as possible. The solutions architect also must reduce false alarms. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible.
options.B: Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the metrics and react to issues quickly.
options.C: Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries to monitor the application and raise an alarm.
options.D: Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible.

declencheurs: no action on short CPU burst >50%
act if CPU>50% AND high read IOPS together
radar.signal: Declencher seulement sur une combinaison de conditions -> Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms

pieges.B: Des dashboards visualisent mais ne declenchent pas d'alarme conditionnelle
pieges.C: Les canaries Synthetics testent la disponibilite applicative, pas des combinaisons de metriques infra
pieges.D: Une alarme sur une seule metrique (meme multi-seuils) ne combine pas CPU ET IOPS

explication: Une composite alarm CloudWatch combine plusieurs alarmes par une logique (ET/OU) : on ne declenche que si CPU > 50 % ET IOPS de lecture eleves en meme temps, ignorant les pics de CPU isoles. Cela reduit les fausses alertes, ce qu'une alarme mono-metrique ne permet pas.

question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to AWS. According to the company compliance requirements, the company can use only the ap-northeast-3 Region. Company administrators are not permitted to connect VPCs to the internet. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.B: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPs) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.D: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3.
options.E: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3.

radar.signal: Residence des donnees + interdiction d'Internet a l'echelle de l'organisation -> AWS Control Tower data residency guardrails (A) ou SCP AWS Organizations (C)

pieges.B: AWS WAF filtre le trafic applicatif, il n'empeche pas l'acces Internet des VPC ni ne restreint les Regions
pieges.D: Des NACL + IAM par utilisateur = fragile, non centralise et incomplet
pieges.E: AWS Config detecte/alerte apres coup, il n'empeche pas (pas de prevention)

explication: Deux approches preventives et centralisees conviennent : les data residency guardrails d'AWS Control Tower (A), qui interdisent l'acces Internet et bloquent les Regions hors ap-northeast-3, et des Service Control Policies AWS Organizations (C) qui empechent les VPC d'obtenir un acces Internet et refusent les autres Regions. WAF et Config (detection) ne previennent pas.

question: A gaming company hosts a browser-based application on AWS. The users of the application consume a large number of videos and images that are stored in Amazon S3. This content is the same for all users. The application has increased in popularity, and millions of users worldwide are accessing these media files. The company wants to provide the files to the users while reducing the load on the origin. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator in front of the web servers.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront web distribution in front of the S3 bucket.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis instance in front of the web servers.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance in front of the web servers.

radar.signal: Diffuser du contenu statique identique mondialement en dechargeant l'origine -> Amazon CloudFront devant le bucket S3

pieges.A: Global Accelerator accelere le reseau mais ne met pas en cache le contenu pour decharger l'origine
pieges.C: ElastiCache Redis met en cache des donnees applicatives, pas des fichiers media pour le monde entier
pieges.D: ElastiCache Memcached idem : pas un CDN

explication: Comme le contenu est identique pour tous, CloudFront le met en cache aux points de presence proches des utilisateurs : la majorite des requetes est servie depuis le cache, ce qui reduit fortement la charge sur le bucket S3 d'origine et le cout, tout en accelerant la diffusion mondiale.

question: A company has a multi-tier application that runs six front-end web servers in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect needs to modify the infrastructure to be highly available without modifying the application. Which architecture should the solutions architect choose that provides high availability?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses three instances across each of two Regions.
options.B: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use three instances across each of two Availability Zones.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling template that can be used to quickly create more instances in another Region.
options.D: Change the ALB in front of the Amazon EC2 instances in a round-robin configuration to balance traffic to the web tier.

declencheurs: 6 web servers in a SINGLE AZ behind ALB
radar.signal: Rendre le tier web HA -> etendre l'Auto Scaling group sur deux AZ (trois instances par AZ)

pieges.A: Repartir sur deux Regions est excessif et complexe pour de la simple HA
pieges.C: Un template pour creer des instances 'au besoin' n'apporte pas la HA active
pieges.D: Le round-robin de l'ALB ne cree pas de redondance multi-AZ

explication: Le point faible est le deploiement dans une seule AZ. En modifiant l'Auto Scaling group pour repartir les instances sur deux Availability Zones (trois par AZ), la perte d'une AZ n'interrompt pas le service. C'est de la haute disponibilite sans toucher a l'application.

question: A company uses AWS Cost Explorer to monitor its AWS costs. The company notices that Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage and snapshot costs increase every month. However, the company does not purchase additional EBS storage every month. The company wants to optimize monthly costs for its current storage usage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor the storage utilization of Amazon EBS. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.B: Use a custom script to monitor space usage. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.C: Delete all expired and unused snapshots to reduce snapshot costs.
options.D: Delete all nonessential snapshots. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create and manage the snapshots according to the company's snapshot policy requirements.

declencheurs: EBS storage AND snapshot costs grow monthly
radar.signal: Cout des snapshots qui gonfle -> supprimer les snapshots non essentiels + Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager pour gerer leur cycle de vie

pieges.A: CloudWatch Logs + Elastic Volumes cible la taille des volumes, pas l'accumulation de snapshots
pieges.B: Script custom = overhead operationnel
pieges.C: Supprimer une fois les snapshots ne previent pas l'accumulation future

explication: L'augmentation vient de l'accumulation des snapshots. En supprimant les snapshots non essentiels puis en confiant leur creation/retention a Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (selon la politique de l'entreprise), on evite durablement l'accumulation avec un minimum d'operations, contrairement a un nettoyage ponctuel ou a un script maison.

question: A company is developing a new application on AWS. The application consists of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster, an Amazon S3 bucket that contains assets for the application, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database that contains the dataset for the application. The dataset contains sensitive information. The company wants to ensure that only the ECS cluster can access the data in the RDS for MySQL database and the data in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the KMS key policy includes encrypt and decrypt permissions for the ECS task execution role.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the S3 bucket policy specifies the ECS task execution role as a user.
options.C: Create an S3 bucket policy that restricts bucket access to the ECS task execution role. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in.
options.D: Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from only the S3 VPC endpoint.

declencheurs: only ECS cluster can access RDS and S3
radar.signal: Restreindre l'acces a la seule identite/au seul reseau ECS -> bucket policy S3 limitee au role de tache ECS + acces RDS limite par security group aux subnets ECS

pieges.A: Le chiffrement KMS protege les donnees mais ne restreint pas QUI accede a la base/au bucket
pieges.B: SSE avec cle AWS managed + role en 'user' ne cible pas l'acces reseau/identite proprement
pieges.D: Restreindre S3 au seul VPC endpoint autorise toute ressource du VPC, pas seulement ECS

explication: Pour que seul le cluster ECS accede aux donnees, on restreint le bucket S3 au role de tache ECS (controle par identite) et on limite l'acces a RDS via son security group aux subnets ou ECS lance ses taches. Le chiffrement (A/B) ne controle pas l'acces, et restreindre S3 au VPC endpoint (D) ouvrirait a toute ressource du VPC.

question: A company sets up an organization in AWS Organizations that contains 10 AWS accounts. A solutions architect must design a solution to provide access to the accounts for several thousand employees. The company has an existing identity provider (IdP). The company wants to use the existing IdP for authentication to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create IAM users for the employees in the required AWS accounts. Connect IAM users to the existing IdP. Configure federated authentication for the IAM users.
options.B: Set up AWS account root users with user email addresses and passwords that are synchronized from the existing IdP.
options.C: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Connect IAM Identity Center to the existing IdP. Provision users and groups from the existing IdP.
options.D: Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share access to the AWS accounts with the users in the existing IdP.

radar.signal: Acces federe a plusieurs comptes via un IdP existant -> AWS IAM Identity Center connecte a l'IdP, provisionnement des utilisateurs/groupes

pieges.A: Creer des IAM users par employe dans chaque compte ne passe pas a l'echelle
pieges.B: Synchroniser des root users est une pratique interdite et dangereuse
pieges.D: AWS RAM partage des ressources, il ne gere pas l'authentification federee

explication: AWS IAM Identity Center se connecte a l'IdP existant (SAML/SCIM) et provisionne utilisateurs et groupes pour un acces SSO a tous les comptes de l'organisation. C'est la solution manageee et scalable, la ou creer des IAM users par compte serait ingerable pour des milliers d'employes.

question: A solutions architect is designing an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) authorization model for a company's AWS account. The company has designated five specific employees to have full access to AWS services and resources in the AWS account. The solutions architect has created an IAM user for each of the five designated employees and has created an IAM user group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Attach the AdministratorAccess resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employees' IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.B: Attach the SystemAdministrator identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employees' IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.C: Attach the AdministratorAccess identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employees' IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.D: Attach the SystemAdministrator resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employees' IAM users in the IAM user group.

radar.signal: Accorder l'acces complet a un groupe -> attacher la policy identity-based geree AdministratorAccess au groupe, y placer les 5 utilisateurs

pieges.A: AdministratorAccess est une policy identity-based, pas resource-based
pieges.B: SystemAdministrator n'accorde pas l'acces COMPLET a tous les services
pieges.D: SystemAdministrator n'est pas une policy resource-based et n'octroie pas le full access

explication: La policy geree AdministratorAccess (identity-based) donne l'acces complet aux services et ressources. On l'attache au groupe IAM et on y place les cinq utilisateurs. SystemAdministrator est plus restreinte que le full access, et ces policies s'attachent a des identites, pas comme des resource-based policies.

question: A company runs multiple workloads in its on-premises data center. The company data center cannot scale fast enough to meet the company's expanding business needs. The company wants to collect usage and configuration data about the on-premises servers and workloads to plan a migration to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set the home AWS Region in AWS Migration Hub. Use AWS Systems Manager to collect data about the on-premises servers.
options.B: Set the home AWS Region in AWS Migration Hub. Use AWS Application Discovery Service to collect data about the on-premises servers.
options.C: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to create the relevant templates. Use AWS Trusted Advisor to collect data about the on-premises servers.
options.D: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to create the relevant templates. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to collect data about the on-premises servers.

declencheurs: collect usage and configuration data about on-prem servers/workloads
radar.signal: Decouvrir/collecter les donnees des serveurs on-prem pour planifier la migration -> AWS Migration Hub (home Region) + AWS Application Discovery Service

pieges.A: Systems Manager gere des instances, il n'est pas l'outil de decouverte pour la planification de migration
pieges.C: SCT convertit des schemas de base ; Trusted Advisor ne collecte pas de donnees on-prem
pieges.D: SCT/DMS concernent les bases de donnees, pas l'inventaire des serveurs

explication: AWS Application Discovery Service collecte les donnees d'utilisation et de configuration des serveurs on-prem, et AWS Migration Hub (dont on definit la home Region) centralise ces informations pour planifier la migration. SCT/DMS sont dedies aux bases, et Systems Manager n'est pas un outil de decouverte de migration.

question: A company has an organization in AWS Organizations that has all features enabled. The company requires that all API calls and logins in any existing or new AWS account must be audited. The company needs a managed solution to prevent additional work and to minimize costs. The company also needs to know when any AWS account is not compliant with the AWS Foundational Security Best Practices (FSBP) standard. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Deploy an AWS Control Tower environment in the Organizations management account. Enable AWS Security Hub and AWS Control Tower Account Factory in the environment.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Control Tower environment in a dedicated Organizations member account. Enable AWS Security Hub and AWS Control Tower Account Factory in the environment.
options.C: Use AWS Managed Services (AMS) Accelerate to build a multi-account landing zone (MALZ). Submit an RFC to self-service provision Amazon GuardDuty in the MALZ.
options.D: Use AWS Managed Services (AMS) Accelerate to build a multi-account landing zone (MALZ). Submit an RFC to self-service provision AWS Security Hub in the MALZ.

declencheurs: audit all API calls and logins in existing/new accounts
radar.signal: Gouvernance multi-comptes manageee + conformite FSBP -> AWS Control Tower (compte de gestion) + Security Hub + Account Factory

pieges.B: Control Tower se deploie dans le compte de GESTION de l'organisation, pas un membre dedie
pieges.C: AMS Accelerate + RFC pour GuardDuty = plus de travail et GuardDuty ne verifie pas la conformite FSBP
pieges.D: AMS Accelerate + RFC = overhead superieur a Control Tower natif

explication: AWS Control Tower deploie une landing zone manageee (audit CloudTrail des appels d'API et connexions sur tous les comptes existants et nouveaux via Account Factory). Security Hub evalue automatiquement la conformite au standard FSBP. Deploye dans le compte de gestion, c'est la solution avec le moins d'overhead.

question: A company runs container applications by using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. The workload is not consistent throughout the day. A solutions architect notices that the number of nodes does not automatically scale out when the existing nodes have reached maximum capacity in the cluster, which causes performance issues. Which solution will resolve this issue with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Scale out the nodes by tracking the memory usage.
options.B: Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to manage the number of nodes in the cluster.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to resize the EKS cluster automatically.
options.D: Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to distribute the workload.

declencheurs: nodes do not scale out at max capacity
radar.signal: Ajuster automatiquement le nombre de NOEUDS d'un cluster EKS -> Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler

pieges.A: Suivre la memoire pour scaler les noeuds ne resout pas nativement le manque de capacite de noeuds
pieges.C: Une Lambda de redimensionnement = solution custom a maintenir
pieges.D: Un EC2 Auto Scaling group brut ne s'integre pas a la logique de scheduling Kubernetes comme le Cluster Autoscaler

explication: Le Horizontal Pod Autoscaler ajuste le nombre de pods, mais pas le nombre de noeuds. Le Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler ajoute/retire des noeuds quand les pods ne peuvent plus etre planifies faute de capacite, resolvant le probleme avec le moins d'administration.

question: A company maintains about 200 TB in Amazon S3 Standard storage month after month. The S3 objects are each typically around 50 GB in size and are frequently replaced with multipart uploads by their global application. The number and size of S3 objects remain constant, but the company's S3 storage costs are increasing each month. How should a solutions architect reduce costs in this situation?

options.A: Switch from multipart uploads to Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.B: Enable an S3 Lifecycle policy that deletes incomplete multipart uploads.
options.C: Configure S3 inventory to prevent objects from being archived too quickly.
options.D: Configure Amazon CloudFront to reduce the number of objects stored in Amazon S3.

declencheurs: objects frequently replaced by multipart uploads
radar.signal: Cout qui gonfle malgre un volume constant + multipart frequents -> Lifecycle policy qui supprime les multipart uploads incomplets

pieges.A: Transfer Acceleration accelere l'upload, il n'a pas d'effet sur le cout de stockage
pieges.C: S3 Inventory dresse un etat, il ne supprime pas les parts orphelines
pieges.D: CloudFront est un CDN, sans effet sur le stockage residuel

explication: Des multipart uploads frequents laissent des parts incompletes/abandonnees qui continuent d'occuper (et de facturer) du stockage, ce qui explique la hausse malgre un volume 'utile' constant. Une Lifecycle policy qui supprime automatiquement les multipart uploads incomplets elimine ce cout cache.

question: A company is designing a solution to capture customer activity in different web applications to process analytics and make predictions. Customer activity in the web applications is unpredictable and can increase suddenly. The company requires a solution that integrates with other web applications. The solution must include an authorization step for security purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Authorization is resolved at the GWLB.
options.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis data stream that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization.
options.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway endpoint in front of an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose that stores the information that the company receives in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use an API Gateway Lambda authorizer to resolve authorization.
options.D: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in front of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) container instance that stores the information that the company receives on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Use an AWS Lambda function to resolve authorization.

radar.signal: Ingestion scalable vers S3 + integration API + autorisation -> API Gateway + Kinesis Data Firehose (vers S3) + Lambda authorizer

pieges.A: GWLB + ECS + EFS n'est pas une ingestion analytique scalable ; l'autorisation au GWLB n'a pas de sens
pieges.B: Kinesis Data Streams stocke moins directement vers S3 que Firehose et exige plus de gestion
pieges.D: GWLB/ECS/EFS ne repond pas au besoin d'ingestion elastique et d'autorisation d'API

explication: API Gateway expose un endpoint integrable aux autres applications, avec un Lambda authorizer pour l'etape d'autorisation. Kinesis Data Firehose ingere l'activite de facon elastique (pics soudains) et la depose directement dans S3 pour l'analyse, le tout manage.

question: An ecommerce company wants a disaster recovery solution for its Amazon RDS DB instances that run Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise Edition. The company's current recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) are 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a cross-Region read replica and promote the read replica to the primary instance.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create RDS cross-Region replication.
options.C: Use cross-Region replication every 24 hours to copy native backups to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Copy automatic snapshots to another Region every 24 hours.

radar.signal: DR a RPO/RTO larges (24h) au moindre cout -> copier les snapshots automatiques vers une autre Region toutes les 24h

pieges.A: Un cross-Region read replica tourne en continu = plus cher et RTO surdimensionne pour 24h
pieges.B: DMS en replication continue coute plus cher qu'une simple copie de snapshots quotidienne
pieges.C: Des native backups vers S3 repliques = plus d'etapes manuelles a orchestrer

alerte_cle: La cle du fichier indique B (DMS), mais une replication DMS continue coute plus cher que necessaire pour un RPO/RTO de 24h. La solution la plus economique est de copier les snapshots vers une autre Region toutes les 24h : reponse D.
explication: Avec un RPO et un RTO de 24 heures, inutile de payer une replication continue (DMS, option B) ou une replica active (A). Copier les snapshots automatiques vers une Region secondaire toutes les 24 heures respecte l'objectif au cout le plus bas : c'est la reponse la plus economique (D).

question: A company is using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt AWS Lambda environment variables. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the required permissions are in place to decrypt and use the environment variables. Which steps must the solutions architect take to implement the correct permissions? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda resource policy.
options.B: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda execution role.
options.C: Add AWS KMS permissions in the Lambda function policy.
options.D: Allow the Lambda execution role in the AWS KMS key policy.
options.E: Allow the Lambda resource policy in the AWS KMS key policy.

radar.signal: Autoriser Lambda a dechiffrer avec KMS -> permissions KMS dans le role d'execution Lambda (B) + autoriser ce role d'execution dans la KMS key policy (D)

pieges.A: La resource policy de Lambda controle qui invoque la fonction, pas l'acces a KMS
pieges.C: La 'function policy' (resource policy) ne gere pas les permissions KMS
pieges.E: On autorise un role/principal dans la key policy, pas une 'resource policy'

explication: Le dechiffrement suit le modele a deux volets de KMS : d'un cote, le role d'execution de la Lambda doit avoir les permissions KMS (B) ; de l'autre, la key policy de la cle KMS doit autoriser ce role d'execution (D). Les deux sont necessaires. La resource policy de Lambda ne concerne que l'invocation.

question: A company has a financial application that produces reports. The reports average 50 KB in size and are stored in Amazon S3. The reports are frequently accessed during the first week after production and must be stored for several years. The reports must be retrievable within 6 hours. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Glacier after 7 days.
options.B: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 7 days.
options.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to transition the reports to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) and S3 Glacier.
options.D: Use S3 Standard. Use an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the reports to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.

radar.signal: Petits objets, acces rare apres 7 jours, recuperation immediate (<6h) -> S3 Standard puis Lifecycle vers S3 Standard-IA apres 7 jours

pieges.A: S3 Glacier peut depasser 6h en recuperation et penalise les petits objets (50 KB)
pieges.C: Intelligent-Tiering vers Glacier risque des delais de recuperation et une surcharge pour de petits objets
pieges.D: Glacier Deep Archive a une recuperation de ~12h, au-dela des 6h exigees

explication: Apres la premiere semaine d'acces frequent, les rapports deviennent rarement consultes : une transition vers S3 Standard-IA reduit le cout de stockage tout en gardant une recuperation instantanee (bien en dessous des 6h). Glacier/Deep Archive risqueraient de depasser 6h et penalisent des objets de 50 KB.

question: A company is using a content management system that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance contains both the web server and the database software. The company must make its website platform highly available and must enable the website to scale to meet user demand. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the database to Amazon RDS, and enable automatic backups. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer in the Availability Zone, and set the two instances as targets.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora instance with a read replica in the same Availability Zone as the existing EC2 instance. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer and set the two EC2 instances as targets.
options.C: Move the database to Amazon Aurora with a read replica in another Availability Zone. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.
options.D: Move the database to a separate EC2 instance, and schedule backups to Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the original EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.

radar.signal: Rendre HA et scalable un CMS mono-instance -> base sur Aurora avec read replica dans une autre AZ + AMI + ALB sur deux AZ + Auto Scaling group multi-AZ

pieges.A: RDS + seconde instance dans la MEME AZ + ALB sur une seule AZ n'est pas hautement disponible
pieges.B: Aurora + replica et EC2 dans la MEME AZ ne survivent pas a une panne d'AZ
pieges.D: Garder la base sur EC2 (auto-gere) est moins fiable et scalable qu'Aurora

explication: Il faut separer et rendre chaque couche redondante sur plusieurs AZ : la base migre vers Aurora avec un read replica dans une autre AZ, et le web devient une AMI deployee via un Auto Scaling group derriere un ALB reparti sur deux AZ. Les options gardant les composants dans une seule AZ ne resistent pas a une panne d'AZ.

question: A company is launching an application on AWS. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to direct traffic to at least two Amazon EC2 instances in a single target group. The instances are in an Auto Scaling group for each environment. The company requires a development environment and a production environment. The production environment will have periods of high traffic. Which solution will configure the development environment MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Reconfigure the target group in the development environment to have only one EC2 instance as a target.
options.B: Change the ALB balancing algorithm to least outstanding requests.
options.C: Reduce the size of the EC2 instances in both environments.
options.D: Reduce the maximum number of EC2 instances in the development environment's Auto Scaling group.

radar.signal: Reduire le cout de l'environnement de dev -> abaisser le nombre MAXIMUM d'instances de l'Auto Scaling group de dev

pieges.A: Fixer une seule cible casse le minimum de 2 instances requis par la conception
pieges.B: Changer l'algorithme de repartition n'a pas d'effet sur le cout
pieges.C: Reduire la taille des instances dans les DEUX environnements degraderait la prod

explication: L'environnement de dev n'a pas besoin d'encaisser des pics comme la prod. En reduisant la capacite maximale de son Auto Scaling group, on limite le nombre d'instances (donc le cout) en dev sans toucher a la prod ni casser le minimum requis de deux instances.

question: A research company uses on-premises devices to generate data for analysis. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to analyze the data. The devices generate CSV files and support writing the data to an SMB file share. Company analysts must be able to use SQL commands to query the data. The analysts will run queries periodically throughout the day. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon S3 File Gateway mode.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon FSx File Gateway mode.
options.C: Set up an AWS Glue crawler to create a table based on the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an Amazon EMR cluster with EMR File System (EMRFS) to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.E: Set up an Amazon Redshift cluster to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.F: Set up Amazon Athena to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.

declencheurs: devices write CSV to SMB share
radar.signal: SMB->S3 + catalogage + SQL serverless economique -> S3 File Gateway (A) + Glue crawler pour la table (C) + Amazon Athena pour interroger (F)

pieges.B: FSx File Gateway donne acces a FSx, il ne fait pas atterrir les CSV dans S3
pieges.D: Un cluster EMR tourne en continu = pas economique pour des requetes periodiques
pieges.E: Un cluster Redshift persistant coute cher pour des requetes ponctuelles (et fait doublon avec Athena)

alerte_cle: La cle du fichier indique CEF, ce qui melange deux moteurs de requete (Redshift ET Athena) et omet l'ingestion. La combinaison coherente et economique est ACF : S3 File Gateway (atterrissage SMB->S3) + Glue crawler + Athena.
explication: Un S3 File Gateway en mode SMB fait atterrir les fichiers CSV dans S3 (A). Un crawler AWS Glue cree la table/schema (C). Amazon Athena, serverless et facture a la requete, est le plus economique pour des interrogations SQL periodiques (F). Redshift/EMR (clusters persistants) coutent cher pour un usage intermittent, et il n'y a aucune raison de cumuler Redshift et Athena.

question: A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) clusters and Amazon RDS DB instances to build and run a payment processing application. The company will run the application in its on-premises data center for compliance purposes. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Outposts as part of the solution. The solutions architect is working with the company operational team to build the application. Which activities are the responsibility of the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.A: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks.
options.B: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts.
options.C: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment.
options.D: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks.
options.E: Physical maintenance of Outposts components.
options.F: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events.

declencheurs: responsibilities of the company's operational team
radar.signal: Responsabilites CLIENT sur Outposts -> alimentation/reseau resilients vers les racks (A) + securite physique du site (C) + capacite tampon pour ECS (F)

pieges.B: Gerer l'hyperviseur/le stockage/les services AWS incombe a AWS
pieges.D: La disponibilite du materiel dans les racks (alimentations, serveurs, reseau) est geree par AWS
pieges.E: La maintenance PHYSIQUE des composants Outposts est assuree par AWS

alerte_cle: La cle du fichier indique ACE, mais la maintenance physique des composants Outposts (E) releve d'AWS, pas du client. Cote client, c'est la capacite tampon (F). La bonne combinaison est ACF.
explication: Dans le modele de responsabilite partagee d'AWS Outposts, le client fournit une alimentation et un reseau resilients vers les racks (A), assure la securite physique du site (C) et prevoit une capacite supplementaire pour absorber les pannes/maintenances (F). AWS, lui, gere et maintient le materiel Outposts (hyperviseur, disponibilite et maintenance physique des composants), ce qui exclut B, D et E cote client.

question: A company developers want a secure way to gain SSH access on the company's Amazon EC2 instances that run the latest version of Amazon Linux. The developers work remotely and in the corporate office. The company wants to use AWS services as a part of the solution. The EC2 instances are hosted in a VPC private subnet and access the internet through a NAT gateway that is deployed in a public subnet. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a bastion host in the same subnet as the EC2 instances. Grant the ec2:CreateVpnConnection IAM permission to the developers. Install EC2 Instance Connect so that the developers can connect to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the corporate network and the VPC. Instruct the developers to use the Site-to-Site VPN connection to access the EC2 instances when the developers are on the corporate network. Instruct the developers to set up another VPN connection for access when they work remotely.
options.C: Create a bastion host in the public subnet of the VPC. Configure the security groups and SSH keys of the bastion host to only allow connections and SSH authentication from the developers' corporate and remote networks. Instruct the developers to connect through the bastion host by using SSH to reach the EC2 instances.
options.D: Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore IAM policy to an IAM role that is associated with the EC2 instances. Instruct the developers to use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to access the EC2 instances.

radar.signal: Acces securise sans bastion ni cout supplementaire -> role IAM avec AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore + AWS Systems Manager Session Manager

pieges.A: Un bastion + permissions VPN mal choisies ajoute de l'infrastructure et du cout
pieges.B: Un VPN Site-to-Site est couteux et complexe pour du simple acces SSH
pieges.C: Un bastion en subnet public = instance a gerer et surface d'attaque supplementaire

explication: En attachant la policy AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore a un role sur les EC2, les developpeurs se connectent via AWS Systems Manager Session Manager, sans bastion, sans port SSH ouvert ni IP publique. C'est securise, fonctionne depuis n'importe ou et evite tout cout d'infrastructure supplementaire.

question: A pharmaceutical company is developing a new drug. The volume of data that the company generates has grown exponentially over the past few months. The company's researchers regularly require a subset of the entire dataset to be immediately available with minimal lag. However, the entire dataset does not need to be accessed on a daily basis. All the data currently resides in on-premises storage arrays, and the company wants to reduce ongoing capital expenses. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Run AWS DataSync as a scheduled cron job to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket on an ongoing basis.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway with an Amazon S3 bucket as the target storage. Migrate the data to the Storage Gateway appliance.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway with cached volumes with an Amazon S3 bucket as the target storage. Migrate the data to the Storage Gateway appliance.
options.D: Configure an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection from the on-premises environment to AWS. Migrate data to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.

declencheurs: subset immediately available with minimal lag
radar.signal: Garder le sous-ensemble actif en local + reste dans le cloud, pour du block -> Storage Gateway Volume Gateway en cached volumes (cible S3)

pieges.A: DataSync migre en masse, il ne garde pas un cache local du sous-ensemble actif
pieges.B: Un file gateway est pour NFS/SMB, or il s'agit de storage arrays (block)
pieges.D: VPN + EFS = pas de cache local et EFS n'est pas du block iSCSI

explication: Un Volume Gateway en mode cached volumes stocke les donnees primaires dans S3 (reduisant les depenses de stockage local) tout en gardant en cache local le sous-ensemble recemment consulte, disponible avec un lag minimal. Il correspond au stockage block des arrays, contrairement au file gateway (NFS/SMB) ou a EFS.

question: A company wants to securely exchange data between its software as a service (SaaS) application Salesforce account and Amazon S3. The company must encrypt the data at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys (CMKs). The company must also encrypt the data in transit. The company has enabled API access for the Salesforce account. Which solution should they choose?

options.A: Create AWS Lambda functions to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Define the task to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.C: Create Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.D: Create a custom connector for Salesforce to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.

declencheurs: encrypt at rest with KMS CMK
radar.signal: Transfert manage et securise entre une source SaaS (Salesforce) et S3 -> Amazon AppFlow

pieges.A: Des Lambda custom = code a ecrire et maintenir pour l'integration Salesforce
pieges.B: Step Functions orchestre mais il faut coder la tache de transfert
pieges.D: Un connecteur custom = developpement et maintenance a la charge de l'entreprise

explication: Amazon AppFlow est un service d'integration manage avec un connecteur natif Salesforce : il transfere les donnees vers S3 en chiffrant en transit (TLS) et au repos avec des cles KMS gerees par le client, sans code a developper, contrairement aux approches Lambda/Step Functions/connecteur custom.

question: A company is developing a mobile gaming app in a single AWS Region. The app runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The company stores the app data in Amazon DynamoDB. The app communicates by using TCP traffic and UDP traffic between the users and the servers. The application will be used globally. The company wants to ensure the lowest possible latency for all users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Global Accelerator to create an accelerator. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) behind an accelerator endpoint that uses Global Accelerator integration and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the ALB.
options.B: Use AWS Global Accelerator to create an accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind an accelerator endpoint that uses Global Accelerator integration and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the NLB.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront content delivery network (CDN) endpoint. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind the endpoint and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the NLB. Update CloudFront to use the NLB as the origin.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront content delivery network (CDN) endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) behind the endpoint and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the ALB. Update CloudFront to use the ALB as the origin.

radar.signal: TCP+UDP mondial a faible latence -> AWS Global Accelerator + Network Load Balancer (ecoute TCP et UDP)

pieges.A: Un ALB ne gere que HTTP/HTTPS, pas le TCP/UDP brut
pieges.C: CloudFront est pour HTTP(S), il ne route pas du TCP/UDP
pieges.D: CloudFront + ALB : ni l'un ni l'autre ne gerent l'UDP

explication: Le trafic TCP ET UDP impose un Network Load Balancer (seul LB gerant l'UDP). AWS Global Accelerator, place devant, route les utilisateurs mondiaux via le backbone AWS depuis des points de presence proches, pour la latence la plus basse. ALB et CloudFront sont limites au HTTP(S).

question: A company plans to use Amazon ElastiCache for its multi-tier web application. A solutions architect creates a Cache VPC for the ElastiCache cluster and an App VPC for the application's Amazon EC2 instances. Both VPCs are in the us-east-1 Region. The solutions architect must implement a solution to provide the applications' EC2 instances with access to the ElastiCache cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster's security group to allow inbound connection from the applications' security group.
options.B: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster's security group to allow inbound connection from the applications' security group.
options.C: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the peering connection's security group to allow inbound connection from the applications' security group.
options.D: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the Transit VPC's security group to allow inbound connection from the applications' security group.

radar.signal: Relier deux VPC a moindre cout -> VPC peering + routes + regle inbound du SG ElastiCache autorisant le SG des applications

pieges.B: Un Transit VPC/Transit Gateway est plus cher qu'un simple peering pour deux VPC
pieges.C: Une connexion de peering n'a pas de security group (formulation invalide)
pieges.D: Transit VPC = cout et complexite superflus

explication: Pour deux VPC d'une meme Region, le VPC peering est le plus economique : aucun cout horaire, juste le transfert. On ajoute les routes dans les deux VPC et une regle inbound sur le security group d'ElastiCache autorisant le SG des applications. Un Transit VPC/Transit Gateway serait plus couteux et inutile ici.

question: A company is building an application that consists of several microservices. The company has decided to use container technologies to deploy its software on AWS. The company needs a solution that minimizes the amount of ongoing effort for maintenance and scaling. The company cannot manage additional infrastructure. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster.
options.B: Deploy the Kubernetes control plane on Amazon EC2 instances that span multiple Availability Zones.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Specify a desired task number level of greater than or equal to 2.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service with a Fargate launch type. Specify a desired task number level of greater than or equal to 2.
options.E: Deploy Kubernetes worker nodes on Amazon EC2 instances that span multiple Availability Zones. Create a deployment that specifies two or more replicas for each microservice.

radar.signal: Conteneurs sans gerer d'infrastructure -> cluster Amazon ECS (A) + service ECS en launch type Fargate avec desired >= 2 (D)

pieges.B: Gerer le control plane Kubernetes sur EC2 = de l'infrastructure a operer
pieges.C: ECS avec launch type EC2 = on gere encore les instances
pieges.E: Des worker nodes Kubernetes sur EC2 = infrastructure a gerer

explication: AWS Fargate execute les conteneurs sans aucune instance a gerer. On deploie un cluster ECS (A) et un service ECS en launch type Fargate avec au moins deux taches (D) pour la disponibilite et le scaling, sans infrastructure a maintenir, contrairement aux options basees sur EC2/Kubernetes autogere.

question: A company compliance team needs to move its file shares to AWS. The shares run on a Windows Server SMB file share. A self-managed on-premises Active Directory controls access to the files and folders. The company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as part of the solution. The company must ensure that the on-premises Active Directory groups restrict access to the FSx for Windows File Server SMB compliance shares, folders, and files after the move to AWS. The company has created an FSx for Windows File Server file system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Active Directory Connector to connect to the Active Directory. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
options.B: Assign a tag with a Restrict tag key and a Compliance tag value. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
options.C: Create an IAM service-linked role that is linked directly to FSx for Windows File Server to restrict access.
options.D: Join the file system to the Active Directory to restrict access.

declencheurs: AD groups restrict access to shares/folders/files
radar.signal: Preserver les permissions AD sur FSx for Windows -> joindre le systeme de fichiers FSx a l'Active Directory

pieges.A: AD Connector relaie l'authentification mais ne mappe pas les groupes AD a des IAM groups pour des ACL de fichiers
pieges.B: Des tags ne controlent pas des permissions NTFS
pieges.C: Un service-linked role ne gere pas l'acces au niveau des partages/fichiers

explication: En joignant le systeme de fichiers FSx for Windows File Server a l'Active Directory (auto-gere) de l'entreprise, les permissions NTFS existantes basees sur les groupes AD s'appliquent directement aux partages, dossiers et fichiers. Les ACL Windows ne se mappent pas a des IAM groups ni a des tags.

question: A company recently announced the deployment of its retail website to a global audience. The website runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The company wants to provide its customers with different versions of content based on the devices that the customers use to access the website. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront to cache multiple versions of the content.
options.B: Configure a host header in a Network Load Balancer to forward traffic to different instances.
options.C: Configure a Lambda@Edge function to send specific objects to users based on the User-Agent header.
options.D: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up host-based routing to different EC2 instances.
options.E: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up path-based routing to different EC2 instances.

radar.signal: Servir des versions selon l'appareil, au bord -> CloudFront cachant plusieurs versions (A) + Lambda@Edge decidant selon l'en-tete User-Agent (C)

pieges.B: Un host header sur un NLB ne differencie pas selon l'appareil
pieges.D: Global Accelerator + NLB en host-based routing ne lit pas le User-Agent applicatif
pieges.E: Global Accelerator + NLB en path-based routing n'est pas du niveau applicatif User-Agent

explication: CloudFront peut mettre en cache plusieurs variantes du contenu (A), et une fonction Lambda@Edge inspecte l'en-tete User-Agent pour renvoyer la version adaptee a l'appareil (C), au plus pres des utilisateurs. Les NLB (host/path-based) operent au niveau reseau et ne lisent pas le User-Agent.

question: A company has 5 TB of datasets. The datasets consist of 1 million user profiles and 10 million connections. The user profiles have connections as many-to-many relationships. The company needs a performance efficient way to find mutual connections up to five levels. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the datasets. Use Amazon Athena to perform SQL JOIN queries to find connections.
options.B: Use Amazon Neptune to store the datasets with edges and vertices. Query the data to find connections.
options.C: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the datasets. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize connections.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS to store the datasets with multiple tables. Perform SQL JOIN queries to find connections.

declencheurs: mutual connections up to five levels
radar.signal: Requetes de relations multi-niveaux (graphe) -> Amazon Neptune (base de donnees graphe : sommets et aretes)

pieges.A: Des JOIN SQL sur S3 via Athena sont inefficaces pour des relations profondes (5 niveaux)
pieges.C: QuickSight visualise, il ne parcourt pas efficacement un graphe
pieges.D: Des JOIN recursifs sur RDS deviennent tres couteux au-dela de quelques niveaux

explication: Trouver des connexions mutuelles jusqu'a cinq niveaux dans des relations many-to-many est un probleme de graphe. Amazon Neptune, base de donnees graphe manageee (sommets/aretes), parcourt ces relations profondes bien plus efficacement que des JOIN SQL recursifs sur RDS ou Athena.

question: A company needs a secure connection between its on-premises environment and AWS. This connection does not need high bandwidth and will handle a small amount of traffic. The connection should be set up quickly. What is the MOST cost-effective method to establish this type of connection?

options.A: Implement a client VPN.
options.B: Implement AWS Direct Connect.
options.C: Implement a bastion host on Amazon EC2.
options.D: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection.

radar.signal: Liaison securisee rapide et peu couteuse pour un faible trafic -> AWS Site-to-Site VPN

pieges.A: Un client VPN cible des utilisateurs individuels, pas une liaison site a site
pieges.B: Direct Connect est long a mettre en place et couteux (surdimensionne ici)
pieges.C: Un bastion sur EC2 n'est pas une liaison reseau securisee site a site

explication: Un AWS Site-to-Site VPN s'etablit rapidement sur Internet, est peu couteux et chiffre le trafic entre le site et le VPC : ideal pour un faible volume. Direct Connect serait long a provisionner et disproportionne, et un client VPN ou un bastion ne repondent pas au besoin de liaison site a site.

question: A company recently launched a variety of new workloads on Amazon EC2 instances in its AWS account. The company needs to create a strategy to access and administer the instances remotely and securely. The company needs to implement a repeatable process that works with native AWS services and follows the AWS Well-Architected Framework. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use the EC2 serial console to directly access the terminal interface of each instance for administration.
options.B: Attach the appropriate IAM role to each existing instance and new instance. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to establish a remote SSH session.
options.C: Create an administrative SSH key pair. Load the public key into each EC2 instance. Deploy a bastion host in a public subnet to provide a tunnel for administration of each instance.
options.D: Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. Instruct administrators to use their local on-premises machines to connect directly to the instances by using SSH keys across the VPN tunnel.

declencheurs: access and administer EC2 remotely and securely
radar.signal: Acces securise et repetable sans bastion ni cles -> role IAM sur chaque instance + AWS Systems Manager Session Manager

pieges.A: La serial console sert au depannage bas niveau, pas a l'administration courante scalable
pieges.C: Cles SSH + bastion = infrastructure et secrets a gerer
pieges.D: Un VPN Site-to-Site + cles SSH = plus lourd et non necessaire

explication: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager, via un role IAM attache aux instances, ouvre des sessions securisees sans bastion, sans cle SSH ni port ouvert. C'est natif, repetable, journalise et conforme au Well-Architected Framework, avec le moins d'overhead.

question: A company is hosting a static website on Amazon S3 and is using Amazon Route 53 for DNS. The website is experiencing increased demand from around the world. The company must decrease latency for users who access the website. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Replicate the S3 bucket that contains the website to all AWS Regions. Add Route 53 geolocation routing entries.
options.B: Provision accelerators in AWS Global Accelerator. Associate the supplied IP addresses with the S3 bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the IP addresses of the accelerators.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the S3 bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the CloudFront distribution.
options.D: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the new endpoint.

radar.signal: Reduire la latence mondiale d'un site statique S3 -> CloudFront devant le bucket, Route 53 pointant sur la distribution

pieges.A: Repliquer le bucket dans toutes les Regions = couteux et complexe
pieges.B: Global Accelerator est fait pour TCP/UDP, pas pour cacher du contenu web statique
pieges.D: Transfer Acceleration accelere les uploads, pas la diffusion aux utilisateurs

explication: CloudFront met en cache le contenu statique aux points de presence proches des utilisateurs, reduisant la latence mondiale a faible cout. Route 53 pointe vers la distribution. Repliquer le bucket partout serait plus cher, et Transfer Acceleration/Global Accelerator ne repondent pas a de la diffusion web statique.

question: A company used an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance during application testing. Before terminating the DB instance at the end of the test cycle, a solutions architect created two backups. The solutions architect created the first backup by using the mysqldump utility to create a database dump. The solutions architect created the second backup by enabling the final DB snapshot option on RDS termination. The company is now planning for a new test cycle and wants to create a new DB instance from the most recent backup. The company has chosen a MySQL-compatible edition of Amazon Aurora to host the DB instance. Which solutions will create the new DB instance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Import the RDS snapshot directly into Aurora.
options.B: Upload the RDS snapshot to Amazon S3. Then import the RDS snapshot into Aurora.
options.C: Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then import the database dump into Aurora.
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to import the RDS snapshot into Aurora.
options.E: Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to import the database dump into Aurora.

declencheurs: most recent backup = final RDS snapshot
create new Aurora MySQL DB instance
radar.signal: Creer un cluster Aurora MySQL a partir du snapshot RDS le plus recent -> import direct du snapshot RDS dans Aurora (A) ou via AWS DMS (D)

pieges.B: On n'uploade pas un snapshot RDS dans S3 pour l'importer ensuite
pieges.C: Le dump mysqldump n'est pas le backup le plus recent (le snapshot final l'est)
pieges.E: Idem : le dump n'est pas le backup le plus recent

explication: Le backup le plus recent est le snapshot final RDS (pris a la terminaison), pas le dump anterieur. On peut creer le cluster Aurora MySQL en important directement ce snapshot RDS (A) ou en s'appuyant sur AWS DMS (D). Les options C/E utilisent le dump, qui n'est pas le plus recent.

question: A company hosts a multi-tier web application on Amazon Linux Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The company observes that the Auto Scaling group launches more On-Demand Instances when the application end users access high volumes of static web content. The company wants to optimize cost. What should a solutions architect do to redesign the application MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Update the Auto Scaling group to use Reserved Instances instead of On-Demand Instances.
options.B: Update the Auto Scaling group to scale by launching Spot Instances instead of On-Demand Instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to host the static web content from an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function behind an Amazon API Gateway API to host the static website content.

declencheurs: Auto Scaling launches more instances for high volumes of STATIC content
radar.signal: Decharger le contenu statique du compute -> CloudFront servant le statique depuis un bucket S3

pieges.A: Des Reserved Instances reduisent un peu le cout mais ne suppriment pas la charge statique inutile sur EC2
pieges.B: Les Spot reduisent le cout mais ne traitent pas la cause (servir du statique via EC2)
pieges.D: Lambda + API Gateway pour du statique est inadapte (le statique se sert depuis S3/CDN)

explication: Le probleme vient du fait que le contenu statique est servi par les EC2, ce qui declenche du scaling couteux. En deplaçant ce contenu vers S3 et en le diffusant via CloudFront, on decharge les instances : elles ne montent plus en charge pour du statique, ce qui reduit reellement le cout.

question: A company hosts multiple production applications. One of the applications consists of resources from Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Amazon RDS, Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS), and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) across multiple AWS Regions. All company resources are tagged with a tag name of "application" and a value that corresponds to each application. A solutions architect must provide the quickest solution for identifying all of the tagged components. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS CloudTrail to generate a list of resources with the application tag.
options.B: Use the AWS CLI to query each service across all Regions to report the tagged components.
options.C: Run a query in Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to report on the components with the application tag.
options.D: Run a query with the AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor to report on the resources globally with the application tag.

radar.signal: Lister rapidement toutes les ressources portant un tag, globalement -> AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor

pieges.A: CloudTrail journalise des evenements d'API, il ne liste pas les ressources par tag
pieges.B: Interroger chaque service par CLI dans chaque Region = lent et fastidieux
pieges.C: CloudWatch Logs Insights interroge des logs, pas l'inventaire des ressources tagguees

explication: Le Tag Editor d'AWS Resource Groups interroge en une fois toutes les ressources portant un tag donne, a travers les services et les Regions. C'est le moyen le plus rapide d'identifier tous les composants tagues 'application', la ou la CLI service par service serait laborieuse.

question: A company needs to export its database once a day to Amazon S3 for other teams to access. The exported object size varies between 2 GB and 5 GB. The S3 access pattern for the data is variable and changes rapidly. The data must be immediately available and must remain accessible for up to 3 months. The company needs the most cost-effective solution that will not increase retrieval time. Which S3 storage class should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.B: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
options.C: S3 Standard
options.D: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)

declencheurs: access pattern variable and changes rapidly
radar.signal: Pattern d'acces imprevisible + acces immediat -> S3 Intelligent-Tiering

pieges.B: Glacier Instant Retrieval vise des donnees rarement consultees, pas un pattern changeant/frequent
pieges.C: S3 Standard est plus cher si une partie des donnees devient peu consultee
pieges.D: Standard-IA suppose un acces peu frequent connu et facture la recuperation

explication: Comme le pattern d'acces est variable et change rapidement, S3 Intelligent-Tiering deplace automatiquement les objets entre paliers selon l'usage, sans frais de recuperation ni impact sur le temps d'acces. Il optimise le cout sans qu'on ait a connaitre le pattern, contrairement a Standard-IA.

question: A company collects 10 GB of telemetry data daily from various machines. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket in a source data account. The company has hired several consulting agencies to use this data for analysis. Each agency needs read access to the data for its analysts. The company must share the data from the source data account by choosing a solution that maximizes security and operational efficiency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure S3 global tables to replicate data for each agency.
options.B: Make the S3 bucket public for a limited time. Inform only the agencies.
options.C: Configure cross-account access for the S3 bucket to the accounts that the agencies own.
options.D: Set up an IAM user for each analyst in the source data account. Grant each user access to the S3 bucket.

declencheurs: share S3 data from source account
radar.signal: Partager un bucket avec des comptes externes de facon sure et simple -> configurer un acces cross-account vers les comptes des agences

pieges.A: 'S3 global tables' n'existe pas ; repliquer chez chaque agence = complexe et couteux
pieges.B: Rendre le bucket public, meme temporairement, est un risque de securite
pieges.D: Creer un IAM user par analyste dans le compte source = gestion lourde et moins sure

explication: Configurer un acces cross-account (bucket policy + roles assumables par les comptes des agences) permet a chaque agence d'acceder en lecture avec ses propres identites, sans creer d'utilisateurs dans le compte source ni exposer publiquement les donnees. C'est sur et efficace.

question: A company uses Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP in its primary AWS Region for CIFS and NFS file shares. Applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances access the file shares. The company needs a storage disaster recovery (DR) solution in a secondary Region. The data that is replicated in the secondary Region needs to be accessed by using the same protocols as the primary Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to copy the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Replicate the S3 bucket to the secondary Region.
options.B: Create a backup of the FSx for ONTAP volumes by using AWS Backup. Copy the volumes to the secondary Region. Create a new FSx for ONTAP instance from the backup.
